At the heart of it all is Enpal.One+, our AI-powered platform that intelligently connects thousands of energy systems and optimizes electricity consumption and grid feed-in in real time.

Are you ready to work on solutions that deliver more than promises—solutions that improve the quality of life for thousands of households every day? At Enpal, the work you do today helps deliver clean energy tomorrow and creates a lasting impact on the way we generate, manage, and use energy.

Your Tasks

  • You design and implement automations that replace manual processes with scalable workflows

  • You work with tools such as Cursor, Snowflake, Airtable, Power BI, Make, and n8n

  • You build autonomous agent-based systems for pricing, market analysis, and demand forecasting

  • You independently manage projects from analysis and solution design through implementation, ensuring measurable business impact

  • You understand how to design robust data architectures and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation

Your Profile

  • You are currently studying Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field

  • You have already gained initial experience in automation, data analytics, or artificial intelligence

  • You enjoy working with tools such as Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, or similar technologies

  • You have a strong analytical mindset, work in a structured and solution-oriented way, and enjoy solving complex problems pragmatically

  • You take ownership, work independently, and proactively drive initiatives forward.

If you are interested even if you do not meet all the requirements, apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience fulfills every single requirement. ☀️

Work at Germany’s first green unicorn – actively shape the solar energy transition.

The sun shines all over the world – At Enpal you work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

Grown-up business & startup spirit – In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain you’ll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and a ping-pong table to fully stocked drink fridges and barista coffee.

Stay up to date & help shape things – transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making paths, and an open feedback culture, because without mistakes there is no progress.

The energy transition only works together – at Enpal you can expect a legendary team spirit and unforgettable team and company events.

Your extra boost – 29 + 2 vacation days, discounted Wellhub membership, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to balance work and life well.

description_html:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you'll do

Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in the Finance (R2R, O2C, MDG) squad and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale.

As Lead Functional Consultant, you own the Finance & SCM architecture across D365 F&O, defining how GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, and Project Accounting are structured, governed, and evolved across 30+ legal entities. You set the design standards that functional consultants, developers, and partners work within, lead the decisions that are hard to reverse, and ensure that the Finance platform is the trusted, auditable system of record that a complex, multi-entity enterprise demands. In the agentic enterprise, you are also the architectural authority for the Finance agent layer, ensuring that Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate on a platform that is deterministic, traceable, and financially compliant.

FINANCE ARCHITECTURE & AGENTIC FOUNDATION

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Finance architecture across modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, and Cost Accounting

  • Design the architectural foundation for Finance AI agents, ensuring the D365 core provides the deterministic ledger, traceable decisions, and full audit trail that agentic operations require

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements (IFRS/local GAAP), and global design principles across all legal entities

  • Translate complex Finance business requirements into robust D365 F&O designs, clean-core first, with customizations only where legally required or business-critical

STANDARDIZATION & GLOBAL ROLLOUT

  • Drive standardization, harmonization, and process simplification across regions and legal entities, ensuring the pilot BU design is locked and rolled out consistently

  • Ensure all Finance solutions are designed in a reliable, robust, and scalable way, ready for rollout across 30+ legal entities in the M9–M15 timeframe

  • Lead solution governance, blueprinting, and architectural decision-making across the Finance domain

  • Provide thought leadership on best practices, industry trends, and Microsoft ecosystem capabilities, including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Fabric

DELIVERY LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

  • Provide hands-on guidance to functional consultants, developers, and integration teams, ensuring high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare

  • Ensure high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and support phases

  • Represent Finance architecture in ERP governance forums, design authority reviews, and steering committees up to CFO level

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in ERP Finance & SCM transformation, with significant hands-on experience in D365 F&O Finance across multiple modules and global rollouts

  • Proven architectural leadership designing end-to-end Finance solutions, including integrations, data models, extensions, and ISV evaluations, ideally within high-growth or complex organizations

  • Deep functional expertise in core Finance processes (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, Cost Accounting) and strong understanding of IFRS/local GAAP

  • Strong fluency in D365 F&O architecture, including data entities and integration patterns

  • Understanding of or strong interest in agentic AI in Finance: how Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate, and what the platform must provide to support them

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, including Finance Directors and CFO, with clear communication and decision-making

  • Experience leading global implementations across multiple legal entities, including fit-gap analysis, blueprinting, solution governance, and change management

  • Collaborative leadership mindset that brings cross-functional teams together and drives clarity in complex global programs

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

Why this role matters

Finance is the most governance-critical domain in Enpal's ERP transformation. In the agentic enterprise, Finance agents, Continuous Close, Revenue Assurance, Collections & Credit, will automate the workflows that today consume weeks of manual effort across 30+ legal entities. As Lead Functional Consultant – D365 F&O Finance & SCM, you design the platform those agents operate on. The quality of your architecture directly determines the auditability, accuracy, and scalability of Enpal's financial operations at scale.

title: Partner Success Manager (w/m/d)

description_html:
Als Partner Success Manager (m/w/d) sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Partner Enpal Financial Solutions erfolgreich nutzen und langfristig erfolgreich mit uns zusammenarbeiten. Du begleitest sie vom Onboarding bis in den laufenden Alltag, hilfst bei operativen Herausforderungen, erkennst Aktivierungspotenziale und stellst sicher, dass unsere Finanzierungslösung im Vertriebsprozess wirklich genutzt wird.

Dabei bist Du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für unsere Partner und deren Kunden, sondern ein zentraler Hebel für Partnererfolg, Prozessqualität und Wachstum. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen, bringst Feedback aus dem Markt direkt ins Unternehmen ein und hilfst dabei, unsere Abläufe, Tools und Wissensbasis kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Die Rolle ist ideal für Dich, wenn Du Verantwortung übernehmen, strukturiert arbeiten und in einem dynamischen Umfeld echten Impact haben möchtest.

Dein Spielfeld

Partneraktivierung & Partnererfolg

  • Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass sie EFS aktiv und erfolgreich nutzen.

  • Du begleitest neue Partner durch ein strukturiertes Onboarding und schaffst die Grundlage für einen schnellen, reibungslosen Start.

  • Du verantwortest die Performance deines Partnerportfolios anhand definierter KPIs.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Nutzung, Aktivierung oder Abschlussraten hinter den Möglichkeiten zurückbleiben, und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein.

  • Du identifizierst inaktive oder gefährdete Partner frühzeitig und unterstützt dabei, diese wieder erfolgreich zu aktivieren.

  • Du analysierst Installations- und Abschlusszahlen und leitest daraus verständliche, relevante Insights für andere Teams ab.

Endkunden- & Installateur-Support

  • Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für operative Fragen von Installateuren, deren Vertriebsteams und Endkunden.

  • Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen schnell, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und sorgst für eine verlässliche Betreuung im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Du priorisierst und eskalierst komplexe Fälle sinnvoll und arbeitest eng mit internen Teams an nachhaltigen Lösungen.

Prozesse, Wissen & Strategie

  • Du baust unsere Knowledge Base aktiv weiter aus und erstellst Support-Artikel, FAQs und Onboarding-Materialien.

  • Du dokumentierst wiederkehrende Herausforderungen aus dem Partneralltag und leitest Verbesserungspotenziale für Prozesse, Tools und Zusammenarbeit ab.

  • Du bringst strukturiertes Feedback aus dem Markt in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und internen Abläufe ein.

  • Du hilfst dabei, ein skalierbares Partner-Success-Setup mit klaren Standards, guter Dokumentation und hoher Prozessqualität aufzubauen.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bringst erste relevante Erfahrung in Customer Success, B2B-Support, Account Management, Operations oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und empathisch – sowohl mit Partnern als auch intern.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Themen gleichzeitig den Überblick.

  • Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse nicht nur zu leben, sondern aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools wie Chat- oder Ticketsystemen.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau und kommunizierst sicher und fließend auf Englisch in einem professionellen Umfeld.

Was Dich bei EFS erwartet

  • Echter Impact: Du gestaltest den Erfolg unserer Partner und unser Wachstum aktiv mit.

  • Ownership ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Steile Lernkurve: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Operations und Product.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus Performance-Bonus mit klaren Zielen.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Viel Raum, um mit uns zu wachsen.

description_html:
Unser Unternehmen

Mindpeak ist ein in Hamburg ansässiges KI-Unternehmen, das sich der Demokratisierung der Krebsdiagnostik verschrieben hat. Unsere Software unterstützt Patholog:innen dabei, Krebserkrankungen schneller und genauer zu erkennen, indem sie modernste Deep-Learning-Verfahren auf medizinische Bilder anwendet. Unsere KI-Lösung ist die erste, die in den USA in der klinischen Histopathologie für die Primärdiagnostik eingesetzt wird, und wird weltweit in Routineabläufen genutzt.

Wir stellen uns einer zentralen Herausforderung im modernen Gesundheitswesen: dem wachsenden Bedarf an medizinischer Bildanalyse bei einer gleichbleibenden Anzahl an Krebsexpert:innen. Durch die Bereitstellung leistungsstarker, robuster Tools für die visuelle Diagnose helfen wir Patholog:innen, sich auf das zu konzentrieren, was nur Menschen am besten können – während unsere Technologie den Rest übernimmt.

Die Stelle

Wir suchen für 6 Monate jemanden proaktives und detailorientiertes im Bereich Office Management (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung in unserem Management and Operations Team. In dieser Rolle bist du ein:e wichtige:r Ansprechpartner:in für das gesamte Team und erhältst Einblicke in verschiedene Geschäftsbereiche, in denen du deine Stärken einbringen kannst. Du kümmerst dich regelmäßig um Bestellungen und die Ordnung im Büro und unterstützt unser Office Management bei diversen anfallenden Aufgaben. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher auf Deutsch und auf Englisch. Diese Position bietet die wertvolle Gelegenheit, in einem agilen, innovativen Umfeld zu arbeiten und direkt zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beizutragen.

  • Work as an on-the-ground extension of Product, Partnership, and Sales, bringing real-world insight back into the roadmap.

  • Deep expertise in creative production pipelines (VFX, animation, motion graphics, or production) and designing new workflows using generative AI

  • A track record of building new things in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation, able to act as a strategic consultant to senior creative and business leaders.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI creative tools (Luma, Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion).

  • A public profile as a creator or thought leader in emerging tech or generative art.

title: Deployment Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Lyceum
description_html:
The Role

Deploying the infrastructure our compute runs on is one of the most important missions at Lyceum. This role secures that infrastructure and brings it online – from the data center it lives in to the GPU clusters that power everything we do.

You will map the European data center landscape, assess which sites are available and which are genuinely worth pursuing on both commercial and technical grounds, and take ownership of deployment: the hands-on work of designing, procuring, and bringing GPU clusters online on site. The role spans sourcing, negotiation, cluster design, procurement, and technical execution, with end-to-end ownership across all of them. Successful candidates rely less on detailed knowledge of specifications than on sound judgment, persistence, and the ability to work effectively with both the providers who control the space and the engineers who rely on it.

What You'll Own

  • Site sourcing and evaluation. Identify and assess data center capacity across Europe, determining which sites are available and worth pursuing on both commercial and technical grounds.

  • Cluster design and procurement. Translate compute requirements into concrete cluster designs, and own the procurement of the hardware needed to bring them to life.

  • Deployment ownership. Lead the technical execution of installing and bringing clusters online within the data center, end to end.

  • Market mapping and relationships. Build and maintain relationships across data center providers and the wider hardware and infrastructure ecosystem, and keep a current, reliable view of available capacity across the market.

  • Cross-functional alignment. Translate cluster requirements into site and provider decisions, and hold delivery to the agreed plan.

What We're Looking For

  • A technical foundation. You've brought a cluster online before, ideally supported by an engineering background (civil, structural, or similar) and several years of relevant professional experience.

  • Exceptional ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes and see them through to completion.

  • Strong interpersonal skills. The role is highly relationship-driven – across providers, vendors, and internal teams – and depends on your ability to build trust and work well with others.

  • Fluency across technical and commercial domains. You can assess a site's engineering realities and evaluate the commercial merits of a deal, moving comfortably between the two.

  • An established network on the hardware and data center side of the industry (not a must).

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

title: Principal Software Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at 1KOMMA5˚
description_html:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Your mission

  • Shape the organisation's technical strategy and innovation efforts
  • Accountable for consistent execution of technical decisions by setting clear direction and holding teams accountable for implementation
  • Ensure continuously that our software architecture is shaped in close alignment with product management to support current and future product direction
  • Lead architectural direction to enable the delivery of scalable, maintainable, and state-of-the-art solutions
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Tackle and resolve deep technical challenges with urgency and precision
  • Mentor and challenge engineers to accelerate their professional growth
  • Build and scale a high-performance tech organisation and engineering culture
  • Embed security and reliability as direct customer value
  • Architect our systems and APIs so AI agents operate as first-class users with machine-readable contracts and structured errors that let agents self-correct
  • Drive the org's transformation to agentic engineering, reshaping how teams work so agents execute safely while humans stay accountable

Technologies you will work with include:

  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Run, Terraform/IaC, Vercel
  • Messaging & IoT: Eclipse Hono, MQTT, Mender
  • Data & BI: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, SQLMesh, Looker
  • Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry
  • Languages: TypeScript (Nest.js), Java, Go, Flutter, Ruby on Rails
  • DevOps: CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro

Your profile

  • Extensive hands-on experience in software development with multiple general-purpose programming languages for a minimum of 5 years
  • A proven track record of architecting scalable and secure systems, demonstrating a strong commitment to quality
  • Extensive experience in designing and implementing APIs that enable seamless integration and system communication
  • An agile and result-oriented mindset, with a strong emphasis on collaboration and teamwork
  • Experience communicating with stakeholders in business terms and understanding the technical implications of their requirements
  • Industry-leading experience driving cross-functional teams and enforcing engineering alignment in fast-paced environments, including making and following through on critical technical decisions
  • Experience designing systems and APIs for agent consumption, with structured errors and clear contracts that let agents self-correct
  • Capability to guide an engineering team through the shift to agentic engineering, reshaping workflows so agents execute safely while humans stay accountable for every outcome
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in German considered a plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time
  • Individualised opportunities for professional development
  • Reporting directly to the CTO

description_html:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Gudensberg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen verantwortungsvollen und verlässlichen Leiter Supply Chain Office (m/w/d) .

Informationen über den Standort und die Ausrüstung, an der du arbeiten wirst.

Unser Betrieb in Gudensberg in Hessen spielt eine essenzielle Rolle bei der Produktion frischer Geflügelspezialitäten. Mit einer großen und innovativen Produktpalette versorgen wir nicht nur den deutschen Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, sondern auch Großverbraucher und die Cateringbranche. Erstklassige Qualität steht dabei immer im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Tätigkeiten

  • Leitung des Planungsprozesses in Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen der Produktionsabteilungen

  • Sicherstellung einer optimalen Auslastung der Produktionskapazität durch ausreichende Warenverfügbarkeiten

  • Optimierung der Ressourcen und Personalplanung in Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen der Produktionsabteilungen

  • Einrichtung einer möglichst effizienten Produktionssteuerung

  • Machbarkeitsprüfungen für die Produktion inkl. Aktionsgeschäft

  • Durchführung von Fortschrittskontrollen bei der Planung und Einleitung von Maßnahmen

  • Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit den Planungsabteilungen der weiteren Werke der Gruppe zurbesseren Erfüllung der Kundenbedürfnisse

  • Verantwortung für die Mitarbeitenden des Supply Chain Office

  • Fachliche Führung der Bereiche Lager und Versand am Standort

Wie sieht der/die ideale Kandidat/- in aus?

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor / Master), vorzugsweise Betriebswirtschaft oder Supply Chain Management bzw. vergleichbare Ausbildung

  • Gute Kenntnisse und Affinität zu Datenverarbeitung und -analyse

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen in der Lebensmittel- oder FMCG-Umgebung ist wünschenswert

  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit Software für die Bedarfsplanung wären ebenfalls hilfreich

  • Gute Kenntnisse der deutschen und englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und gutes Zahlenverständnis

  • Hohe Ergebnis- und Kundenorientierung

  • Ausgeprägte Eigenschaften für Planung und Organisation

  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen und zielgerichteten Informationsflusses innerhalb des Teams sowie zu angrenzenden Fachbereichen.

Das bieten wir

  • Dich erwartet eine spannende Herausforderung mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Mitgestaltung in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Halte dich fit mit unserem Firmenfitnessprogramm – wir bezuschussen deine Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass-Verbundes.

  • Sei umweltfreundlich unterwegs mit unserem E-Bike-Leasing – eine attraktive Option für deine tägliche Mobilität.

  • Sichere dir attraktive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte – ein Plus, das sich lohnt!

  • Parke stressfrei und kostenlos – direkt bei uns am Arbeitsplatz.

  • Empfiehl uns als Arbeitgeber weiter und freue dich über attraktive Prämien, wenn du neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu uns bringst.

  • Dank unseres strukturierten Onboarding-Programms findest du dich schnell zurecht und startest erfolgreich bei uns durch.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns darauf , dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb dich direkt über die grüne Schaltfläche oder das untenstehende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.

Plukon Gudensberg GmbH
Herr Ronny Böhme
Personalabteilung
Besserstr 45, 34281 Gudensberg
Telefon: +49 (0) 1522 2628 934
E-Mail:

Akquise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung ist nicht erwünscht.

Für welches Unternehmen wirst Du arbeiten?

Arbeiten bei Plukon bedeutet, an verantwortungsvoller Ernährung von 265 Mio. Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern in Europa zu arbeiten. Unser Sortiment reicht von Mahlzeitkomponenten bis hin zu Fertiggerichten, darunter Salate. Die Zutaten hierfür sind Geflügelfleischprodukte (unsere Basis), aber immer öfter auch Gemüse und alternative Proteine. So haben wir ein Angebot für Fleischfreundinnen und -freunde, Flexitarierinnen und Flexitarier und Vegetarierinnen und Vegetarier. Sie finden unsere Produkte im Kühlregal von Supermärkten und in Schnellrestaurants.

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!


Disclaimer

title: E-Commerce Campaign Manager (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we’re on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We create the snacks people genuinely crave, from chocolate bars and wafers to cookies, gummies, and protein bars, with up to 90% less sugar and no compromise on taste.

As our E-Commerce Campaign Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of our products, customer experience, and commercial growth. You’ll help shape how ahead brings ideas to life online and scales them across markets.

You’ll take ownership of our onsite campaigns and bring our overarching campaign strategy to life in our shop. You’ll improve the processes behind them, develop & implement new ideas for new campaign-related shop features, and turn campaign data into actionable insights. Working closely with our E-Commerce, Campaign, Brand, and Marketing teams, you’ll help make our campaigns more effective, scalable, and relevant across markets.

If you’re commercially curious, highly detail oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to shape both the customer experience and the way we do e-commerce, we’d love to hear from you!


YOUR TASKS

  • Onsite Campaign Experience & Launches: Plan and execute product launches, discount initiatives, and other commercial activities in the shop. Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Content & Asset Ownership: Coordinate the creation of product and shop content, including images, copy, homepage content, launch pages, and other onsite assets. Take full responsibility for their quality, accuracy, and timely delivery, including localization for expansion markets. Ensure content is adapted to local needs and delivered consistently across countries.

  • Shop Development: Together with our Tech team, transform the campaign vision into new shop features, promotional mechanics, and onsite experiences that can improve customer engagement and commercial performance.

  • Process Improvement: Improve how onsite activities are planned, created, and delivered by establishing clearer workflows, strengthening collaboration and handovers, and reducing avoidable errors. Find ways to shorten delivery timelines and assess recurring tasks for automation or AI support. Develop scalable ways of working while using sound judgment about where communication, coordination, and creative thinking remain essential.

  • Performance & Insights: Analyze completed onsite activities, from product launch revenue and discount uplift to top-selling products and other relevant performance indicators, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for future initiatives.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You have practical experience in onsite campaign management, shop management, e-commerce, or a similar field. Hands-on experience with onsite campaigns or shop management is essential. 

  • You are highly organized, structured, and accurate. You have a low tolerance for errors and take full responsibility for the quality of your work, particularly when managing product copy, campaign assets, and launch details.

  • You combine attention to detail with commercial curiosity. You don’t just execute campaigns – you want to understand what drives performance, what can be improved, and how new ideas can create better results. 

  • You are proactive and hands-on. You identify problems, challenge inefficient processes, and follow through on solutions. You’re comfortable working across a broad range of tasks in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in both German and English. You enjoy coordinating with multiple stakeholders and can work effectively with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand & Design, and other internal teams.

  • You have a basic understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing, and e-commerce performance.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • You are confident working with Shopify. Hands-on Shopify experience is essential for this role.

  • You have worked in a D2C business.

  • You are familiar with Asana, Trello, or similar project management tools.

  • You understand shop and e-commerce performance and how onsite activities can contribute to commercial results.

  • A background in food, consumer goods, retail, or another high-campaign environment is a plus.

  • Experience improving processes, automating tasks, or using AI to work more efficiently is a plus.

  • Exposure to localization and international markets is a plus.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Berlin or Hamburg, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget

This role is based in Hamburg or Berlin, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you! 


Disclaimer

ahead GmbH is an equal opportunity workplace and is devoted to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nc Group
description_html:
About us

NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. 

Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights.
We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data.
  • Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users.
  • Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems.
  • Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps.
  • Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team.
  • Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions.
  • Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges.


Your profile

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and RAG, including building and implementing LLM-powered systems in practice.
  • Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering and programming skills, particularly in Python, with a focus on clean, well-structured, tested, and maintainable code.
  • Good understanding of the design and development of agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • A strong research mindset and enthusiasm for keeping up with developments in AI and translating new approaches into practical solutions.
  • Fluent English, combined with strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
  • Experience productionizing ML solutions in the cloud, preferably AWS (e.g. Bedrock, ECS, S3), using modern AI and LLM tooling such as LangGraph, Chroma, FAISS, LangSmith, or Langfuse, including LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and cost and latency optimization is a plus.
  • Exposure to telecom, networking, signal processing, or other data-rich technical domains is a plus.


We Offer

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
  • Opportunity to shape AI strategy in a fast-growing organization with access to state-of-the-art AI tools, infrastructure, and research opportunities
  • Flexible working hours.
  • 28 vacation days.
  • Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy.
  • Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket.
  • Bicycle leasing via JobRad.
  • Regular Team Events.

title: Senior GTM Strategy Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Chrono24
description_html:
About

Chrono24 is the world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches. Driven by a passion for timepieces and technology, we connect buyers and sellers from across the globe. Our goal is to maximise trust and transparency in the watch market.

About

Growth Operations is the engine room of Chrono24’s commercial execution - connecting Marketing, Supply, and VIP Sales with the analytical rigour and operational structure they need to make faster, better decisions. As Senior GTM Strategy Manager, you will be the analytical and operational backbone of the team, reporting to the Chief of Staff and working directly with Growth leadership - and, where relevant, the broader executive leadership - on the commercial questions that most directly determine our growth trajectory. We use AI tools as a matter of course, not an occasional shortcut. We expect this role to use them to compress the time between question, insight, and decision, and to help raise the standard across the team of what good, AI-enabled work looks like.


What you can expect

  • Own research, modelling, and problem-structuring on high-priority strategic questions (e.g. C2C strategy, new go-to-market motions), building scenario analyses rigorous enough to inform decisions and clear enough to present to executive leadership, using AI tools to move faster and think more rigorously.
  • Take cross-functional initiatives from framing through to delivery - including the messy middle of stakeholder coordination, dependency management, and keeping things moving; synthesise inputs into decision-ready recommendations and bring your own point of view rather than presenting options neutrally.
  • Design and maintain Growth’s internal KPI and performance reporting, working with the Data and BI teams to ensure the right metrics are tracked, defined consistently, and surfaced at the right cadence.
  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across our Marketplace and VIP go-to-market motions, and turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership discussions.
  • Own recurring analytical deliverables, including weekly and monthly performance summaries for the Growth leadership team.
  • Act as a thought partner on high-priority strategic initiatives such as US market acceleration and new go-to-market motions (e.g. CPO, certification, consignment).


What sets you apart

  • 5+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or a GTM / strategy / business operations role at a top-tier, high-growth technology company.
  • You’ve owned outcomes, not just workstreams: as comfortable driving a cross-functional initiative to completion as building the model that justified it.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to build a model, stress-test assumptions, and know when the numbers are telling you something real versus something convenient; you understand what they mean, not just what they say.
  • Fluent with AI tools: you use LLMs, research agents, and analytical co-pilots as a natural part of how you work, and you’re thoughtful about where they help and where human judgment still leads.
  • Commercial instinct and good judgment about where to invest effort; able to communicate findings clearly to senior stakeholders and make structure where there isn’t any.
  • Demonstrated interest in ecommerce and marketplaces; knowledge of luxury resale or the watch market is a plus. Fluent in English; German is a plus.


What we offer

  • A dynamic and international work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute significantly to the expansion and success of our company.
  • Attractive compensation and development opportunities.
  • Benefit App: Discover our Benefit App, which offers you complete flexibility. Whether for your sports programme, as a daycare allowance or as a flexible mobility budget, with an additional monthly budget of €80 per person, you can use the benefits individually and design them according to your wishes!
  • Permanent contract: With a permanent contract, we offer you security and perspective in your career. We focus on long-term collaboration and your growth!
  • 30 days’ vacation: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with 30 days’ vacation a year to relax and gain new inspiration. Your time is valuable - use it how you want!
  • Extra day off on December 24 and 31: Look forward to an extra day off on December 24 and 31 to enjoy the holidays to the full. This leaves more time for family, friends, and festive preparations!
  • Work from abroad 20 days/year: Take advantage of the opportunity to work from abroad for up to 20 days a year and discover new cultures.


Diversity@Chrono24: We believe in the power of diversity.

Diversity is our strength.
At Chrono24, we embrace diversity because we believe it enriches not only our corporate culture but also our success. Be yourself – and let’s achieve great things together!

description_html:
About

Chrono24 is the world's leading marketplace for luxury watches, bringing together watch enthusiasts, collectors, dealers, and buyers from all over the world every day. As a Senior Controller, you'll be part of our Controlling team and actively help shape Chrono24's financial steering. You'll ensure that operational developments are translated into financial impact, take ownership of ongoing cost and P&L controlling including monthly and quarterly reporting, develop scalable controlling and planning processes, and support the Management Board in data-driven decision-making. This role gives you the opportunity to substantially advance our controlling structures — from cost transparency all the way to integrated planning.


What you can expect

  • Financial Steering & Decision Support: You translate operational KPI developments into P&L, EBITDA, and cash impact, and prepare well-founded executive and board materials including commentary
  • Planning, Forecasting & Budget Steering: You drive budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecast processes, steer budgets together with the business units, and develop driver-based financial models as well as integrated cash and working capital planning
  • Cost & Profitability Transparency: You create transparency around OPEX, payment costs, regional contribution margin accounting, and profitability analyses
  • Reporting & Month-End Close: You support the monthly and quarterly close from a controlling perspective, comment on cost and earnings developments, and further develop management and business-unit reporting
  • Systems, Automation & AI: You drive the integration of financials into our data landscape, automate manual processes, and develop AI-supported analysis and commentary workflows
  • Financial Governance: You ensure consistent financial logic (segments, P&L structure, forecast logic) in alignment with BI and Accounting


What sets you apart

  • At least 5 years of experience in Controlling or FP&A, ideally in a digital marketplace or e-commerce environment
  • Solid controlling expertise across the full breadth: cost and P&L controlling, reporting and variance analysis, as well as planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis
  • Ability to translate complex financial relationships into clear, actionable recommendations and communicate them convincingly
  • Experience with ERP/consolidation systems (e.g. LucaNet, DATEV), BI tools (Qlik, Tableau or similar), and planning tools (Pigment, Board or similar)
  • Self-starter mentality, structured way of working, and enthusiasm for actively developing processes and structures
  • Very good English skills, German is a plus

  • A strategically relevant position with real room to shape and build
  • A dynamic, international environment backed by well-known Private Equity investors
  • A modern work environment with flexible hours and hybrid working
  • A benefits app with a monthly allowance of €80 for sports, childcare, or flexible mobility
  • Free lunch that gives you energy and brings the team together
  • A permanent contract with long-term development opportunities

  • The option to work up to 20 days per year from abroad

title: Senior Process Engieer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tozero
description_html:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data

assumptions.

title: Working Student – Invoice Checking (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Letmeship
description_html:
About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel/ LMS Next, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As a Working Student (d/f/m) in our Invoicing Team, you will join us at the earliest possible date and support us with reviewing carrier invoices, contributing to efficient and reliable billing processes. You will be part of an international team of seven colleagues, based across Hamburg, Naarden, Nantes, and Madrid.

You can look forward to a working environment where mutual support, team spirit, and positive collaboration are at the heart of how we work.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for reviewing and checking carrier invoices across different brands and countries.

  • You handle related invoice claims and clarify any discrepancies.

  • You review carrier rates and ensure they are correctly reflected in the invoice checks.

  • You gather the information required for invoice checks from relevant stakeholders and coordinate with them.

  • As part of the invoice checking process for LMS Next, you also support the posting of carrier invoices.

  • You support the testing of improvements to the invoice checking process before they are implemented.

  • You support the implementation of our new accounting system, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.


What you need to succeed

  • You are currently enrolled at a university and would like to gain practical experience in invoice checking, accounts payable/receivable, and an international working environment.

  • You enjoy working with numbers and have a careful and accurate approach to your work.

  • You approach your tasks in a structured, efficient, and independent manner.

  • You are open-minded, curious, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have good to very good proficiency in German and English, enabling you to communicate confidently within our international team.

  • Initial knowledge or experience in the transport and logistics sector is an advantage, but not a requirement.


Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

  • 30 days of vacation

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work 

  • Time tracking and overtime compensation 

  • Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking 

  • SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50

  • Corporate Benefits Program

  • Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute


Join the ITA Crew

You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as a Working Student – Invoice Checking (d/f/m) in beautiful Hamburg?
Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Ulrike Le Quéré is looking forward to your application. 

We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, disabilities, sexual orientations, and religions.

Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if equally qualified.

You can find more information at www.letmeship.com.

title: Sales Solutions Engineer - EMEA
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sonarsource
description_html:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. 
 
As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

What you will do daily
  • Help prospective customers understand how our AC/DC approach fits within their software development life cycle
  • Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations 
  • Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams
  • Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions
  • Provide technical enablement to channel partners to raise their level of service

    • Experience and qualifications
  • Some practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering highly desirable
  • Familiarity of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
  • Passion for technology and successful customer outcomes
  • Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form
  • Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge
  • A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills
  • German language is desirable but not a hard requirement.
    •  

    In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Risk Management
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ppro
description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

At PPRO, Senior Software Engineers make some of the most significant decisions for the company. Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, with a significant impact on the team’s product, but also on its culture and spirit. You will solve complex technical problems, participate in decisions on architecture and technical direction, support and mentor other engineers and work alongside them in the code.

What you’ll do
  • Own products and services end-to-end — backend and UI — including architecting solutions that turn risk into a product, such as our customer
  • facing disputes and chargebacks platform
  • Collaborate and grow in a dynamic and autonomous environment, working to define undefined boundaries in disputes and chargebacks across payment methods
  • Be an integral part of a team, in addition to its culture and ways of working.
  • Common practices include agile methodologies, pair and mob programming
  • Use the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
  • Be part of a team that will take full operational responsibility for the services that you own, ensuring security compliance (GDPR) and potentially taking part in an on-call rotation.
  • Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices

    • What we look for in you
  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset
  • Multiple experiences working with Java and Spring Boot 
  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services
  • Experience with the cloud (preferably AWS) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Experience or a strong interest in the complexities of Disputes or Chargebacks
  • Comfortable making UI changes in React; full stack experience is desirable
  • Great problem solving abilities and the ability to articulate tradeoffs of technical problems to a broad audience 
  • Working proficiency in English

    • Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with:
  • Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
  • AWS Cloud components such as EKS, DynamoDB, Kinesis and OpenSearch.
  • Event-driven architectures
  • React, TypeScript
    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
     
    We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
     
    We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

title: Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Heidi Systems
description_html:
Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.

Wo wir stehen

  • 8 Personen
  • Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals
  • Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI
  • Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026

Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht.

Wir wachsen stark und suchen jemanden, der unsere operativen Abläufe mit aufbaut, übernimmt und kontinuierlich besser macht.

Als Operations Manager bist du für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem gewonnenen Auftrag ein sauber umgesetztes Projekt wird – von der ersten Abstimmung über die Koordination aller Beteiligten bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe und laufenden Betreuung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Founder und dem gesamten Team zusammen, übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung und hast dabei viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Rolle ist ausdrücklich nicht als klassische Verwaltungsposition gedacht: Du ownst deine Themen und sorgst dafür, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst End-to-End Ownership für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben
  • Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick über deine Projekte: Was ist erledigt? Was fehlt? Wer wartet auf wen? Was muss als Nächstes passieren?
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und sorgst für eine klare, schnelle und verlässliche Kommunikation
  • Du identifizierst manuelle und repetitive Abläufe und entwickelst daraus bessere Prozesse und Systeme
  • Du automatisierst operative Abläufe mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools, z. B. n8n oder Claude Code
  • Du baust interne Strukturen für Projekttracking, Dokumentation und Reporting auf und stellst sicher, dass diese im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt werden
  • Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab
  • Du entwickelst unsere Operations gemeinsam mit dem Founder weiter und übernimmst mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche
  • Du treibst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung und misst, ob sie tatsächlich etwas verbessern

Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, z. B. in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Immobilienwirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – alternativ vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in Operations, Projektmanagement, Consulting, einem Startup, Real Estate oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld ist ein Plus
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst klar und verbindlich mit Kunden, Hausverwaltungen, Installateuren und Partnern kommunizieren und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen
  • Du gehst Probleme pragmatisch an und findest Lösungen, statt sie weiterzugeben
  • Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Prozesse
  • Du hast Spaß daran, Dinge selbst aufzubauen und bestehende Abläufe kritisch zu hinterfragen
  • Technikaffinität und Interesse an AI, SaaS, IoT oder Automatisierung sind ein Plus
  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Early-Stage-Startup wohl und kannst mit Unklarheit und wechselnden Prioritäten umgehen
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (nicht verhandelbar) sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit und tägliches Mentoring durch einen erfahrenen Gründer und eine extrem steile Lernkurve
  • Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Deine Projekte gehören dir – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Die Chance, unsere Operations von Anfang an mit aufzubauen und die Prozesse eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen
  • Die Möglichkeit, mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche und perspektivisch ein eigenes Team zu übernehmen
  • Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital
  • Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
  • Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen
