  • Deeply comprehend the needs of different teams, the ability to empathise with them and determine the necessary steps to fulfil their goals

  • Thrives in a challenging and agile environment, showcasing a team-oriented working style and excellent communication skills to rally teams behind your product

  • Familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence, along with experience in handling large amounts of data, ideally using SQL

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken), with proficiency in German or Polish considered a bonus

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

description_html:
Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior IC

Reporting to: Co-founder & CRO

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

Your Role

As our Player-Coach for DACH, you will be the first commercial hire on the ground, carrying a personal quota and closing mid-to-high 6-figure enterprise deals yourself.

As the team grows, you will also act as player-coach, helping hire, onboard, and coach an additional AE, though depending on timing we may bring them on before or after you join.

This is primarily an individual contributor role: your personal pipeline and closing come first, coaching responsibilities grow alongside the team.

You will lead complex, consultative sales cycles - from sourcing deals to managing pilots, navigating multi-stakeholder conversations, and closing 6-digit contracts.

This is not a transactional or inbound-driven role. You're expected to generate pipeline autonomously through your network, industry knowledge, and presence on the ground.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a personal revenue quota, the primary measure of success.

  • Source and close new business opportunities with enterprise/mid-market customers (€100k+ ACV), with a clear path to expanding deal size as the product and market mature.

  • Act as player-coach for the DACH market, supporting and eventually managing an AE as they launch.

  • Run full-cycle consultative sales: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close.

  • Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement

  • Be the face of Nebuly in DACH - at events, in conversations, in the market.

  • Help hire, onboard, and coach an additional AE as the DACH team scales, whether they join before or after you. (new)

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience in DACH

  • Proven track record of closing multiple 7-figure enterprise contracts

  • Comfortable being evaluated primarily on personal quota, with coaching responsibility growing as the team scales

  • Experience managing or mentoring AEs in a high-growth environment

  • Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the DACH enterprise space

  • Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads)

  • You know how to win deals without inbound or SDRs - you drive your own pipeline

  • Experience working alongside system integrators and advisory firms - you know how to bring them into a deal, co-sell with them, and build the relationship that eventually generates referrals.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, a lean process, and building as you go

  • Fluent in German and English

You do not need to have sold AI observability or conversational analytics before. You need to know the buyers and know how to sell.

Bonus Points

  • Experience as first sales manager or team lead in a Series A or B company

  • Background in data, analytics, ML infrastructure, or developer tools

What We Offer

White space. There is no incumbent AE in DACH to step around. The territory is yours.

Real earning potential. €200-240k OTE, 50/50 base variable. Compensation is flexible based on experience and fit.

Equity. You are early. That means something.

No bureaucracy. You will report directly to the Co-founder and have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and field marketing support to help with events. You will start by selling directly - but as you build the first logos in DACH, activating the first partner relationships is part of the job too. A dedicated Partnerships Manager joins once the market has been validated. Until then, the partner motion is yours.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Applied
description_html:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the Role
At Applied Intuition, you will sit directly at the intersection of System Integration and Validation. Rather than just running pre-written scripts, you will build and configure Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) environments from scratch. We need a systemic thinker who thrives in ambiguity—someone who can take incomplete requirements, bridge functional gaps independently, and connect dots across the entire vehicle architecture while working closely with OEM partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Assemble, configure, and initialize dSPACE and Vector HiL test benches, lab cars, and test environments from the ground up for new projects.

  • Build and integrate complex vehicle simulation models in MATLAB/Simulink and link them directly with HiL hardware systems.

  • Analyze high-level system requirements, bridge functional gaps, and design complete validation strategies—even when documentation is minimal or incomplete.

  • Develop robust automation scripts in Python to execute tests across simulated, bench, and prototype vehicle environments.

  • Configure vehicle communication networks and assets (ARXML, K-Matrix) across CAN, Automotive Ethernet, FlexRay, and LIN protocols.

  • Perform deep-dive failure analysis when tests fail, collaborating with core engineering teams and OEM partners to troubleshoot and resolve system-level bugs.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years in automotive systems validation, embedded systems, or hardware integration with broad exposure across multiple vehicle domains (e.g., ADAS, Powertrain, Body, Infotainment) rather than a single-domain focus.

  • Mindset & Ownership: Self-starter with a "can-do" attitude, high energy, and the independence to drive projects forward without waiting for perfect requirements or step-by-step instructions.

  • Hands-on experience building/configuring dSPACE (ControlDesk/ConfigurationDesk) or Vector hardware and software (CANoe, CANape).

  • Proficiency in Python for test automation and MATLAB/Simulink for vehicle model development.

  • Practical knowledge of automotive network protocols (CAN, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, FlexRay) and network files (ARXML, K-Matrix).



Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM-assisted coding workflows to optimize test generation and scripting.

  • Prototype vehicle bring-up and debugging experience in lab or track environments.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

As a Software Engineer - Embedded Systems, you will design, develop and port autonomous software modules across different system-on-chip platforms. You will be an early member of the fast-growing autonomy team in Stuttgart with broad ownership and direct impact on program direction.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Develop and debug our autonomous stack on embedded compute platforms

  • Work closely with machine learning engineers to optimize perception models for embedded performance

  • Strong low-level understanding of hardware accelerators including encoders, DSPs and GPUs

  • Deep knowledge of operating systems, specifically QNX and Linux

  • Hands-on experience with microcontrollers, hardware debuggers and flashing interfaces

Nice to have:

  • Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Computer Science, Robotics, Electronics or related fields

  • Experience with ADAS or autonomous driving systems

  • Machine learning experience, ideally in perception

  • Full product cycle experience from first prototype to series production

Benefits:

  • You’ll receive €965 annual learning & development and €580 annual fitness budget

  • Subsidized Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms, studios, and wellness facilities across Germany

  • €25 monthly contribution to your Deutschlandticket for regional public transport across Germany

  • Generous parental leave: on top of statutory parental leave

title: Senior Data Scientist
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Constructor
description_html:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About The Role

We are hiring Senior Data Scientists across multiple teams at Constructor. Wherever you land, you will work with data from some of the world's largest ecommerce companies, applying statistics and machine learning to problems that directly move business metrics like revenue and conversion rate.

Our data scientists design and analyze experiments, dig into how our ranking, personalization, and recommendation algorithms behave, and connect model performance to real business outcomes. During the interview process we will get to know your strengths and interests and match you with the team where you can have the biggest impact.

What You'll Do

  • Design, run, and analyze A/B tests measuring impact on key business metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit

  • Apply statistical methods and machine learning to solve business and product problems

  • Develop a deep understanding of how our search, ranking, and personalization algorithms work, and how to evaluate and improve them

  • Analyze large-scale behavioral data to generate insights and recommendations for customers and internal teams

  • Build analyses, models, and tools that help teams make better decisions

  • Communicate findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders

Requirements

  • Strong experience solving business problems using data science and statistics

  • Solid knowledge of SQL and experience working with large datasets

  • Strong Python skills for analysis and modeling (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, visualization libraries)

  • Deep understanding of A/B testing, experiment design, and statistical inference

Product & data understanding:

  • Understanding of machine learning systems: how models are trained, evaluated, and tuned

  • Experience connecting model or algorithm performance to product funnels and business metrics

  • Familiarity with ranking, recommendations, or search relevance is a plus

Communication & ownership:

  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and business audiences

  • Comfortable working independently with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

Preferred skills:

  • Experience working in e-commerce or with large-scale user behavioral data

  • Experience in customer-facing analytical work

Benefits

  • 🧠 Work with smart and empathetic people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

  • 🎉 Regular team offsite events to connect and collaborate.

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live.

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees.

  • 💵 Base salary: $80k–$120K USD depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

  • 📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of our listed qualifications.

description_html:
Description

Constructor is an AI-first search and product discovery platform built for enterprise ecommerce, helping leading retailers deliver personalized digital shopping experiences that drive revenue, conversion and profit. Our technology delivers consistent $10M+ lifts for brands including Sephora, Petco, Under Armour and Birkenstock.

We are looking for a Director of Product Marketing to help tell that story.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone exceptional at product positioning, messaging and storytelling. You'll define what makes Constructor genuinely different and translate that into a compelling narrative that resonates with prospects, customers and the market.

Our platform is powerful, technically sophisticated and constantly evolving. We need someone who can bring clarity to that complexity, identify the real value and differentiation of our products, and create positioning that makes customers think: "This is clearly better—and we need it."

This position is equal parts strategist and builder - setting direction, developing people, and rolling up your sleeves to build the many artifacts that form a robust product marketing org. You will work closely with our product leaders to launch new products, add-ons and features, with our content marketing team to create thought leadership, with growth marketing to drive pipeline and product content and with sales to ensure the GTM functions are enabled on key launches and competitors. Any feature or product launch, with the product team, will include a bill of materials focused on value proposition, personas, objection handling, competition and more.

Requirements

Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Own and evolve differentiated positioning for Constructor's platform, products and key capabilities.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what makes our technology unique and valuable to customers.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling customer value propositions.

  • Create messaging that clearly communicates why Constructor, why now and why we're different.

  • Build messaging frameworks and narratives that align Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

  • Ensure our positioning is grounded in genuine product strengths and customer needs, not simply what competitors are saying.

GTM & Product Launches

  • Create compelling product narratives, value propositions and messaging that bring products and capabilities to life.

  • Develop sales enablement and customer-facing materials that support launches, adoption and expansion.

  • Partner with Sales to understand customer needs, objections and deal dynamics, continuously improving positioning and enablement.

  • Lead and orchestrate product launches from strategy through execution that are crisp, focused, and actually land with customers

  • Partner with Product on roadmap communication and prioritization

  • Identify gaps in capabilities and proactively build the function to address them

Customer & Market Insight

  • Build a deep understanding of our customers, prospects, buyers and their challenges.

  • Understand the ecommerce, search and product discovery landscape and where Constructor creates differentiated value.

  • Engage with customers and prospects to understand what resonates and why they choose Constructor.

  • Monitor the market and competitive landscapes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve how we communicate product value throughout the customer lifecycle and the deep understanding of buyer personas and ICP.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8-10 years experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally within a technical or complex product environment.

  • Proven track record developing genuinely differentiated positioning and messaging.

  • Ability to take complex technology and turn it into a simple, compelling story that customers understand and value.

  • Experience bringing products or capabilities to market and creating GTM materials that support adoption and growth.

  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Sales to develop positioning that works both externally and commercially.

  • Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, search, discovery is a plus.

Skills

  • You are a strong storyteller who can communicate complex technical concepts in a simple, clear and persuasive way.

  • You are technically curious, with a good understanding of how products work and what makes technology better, as well as a familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals.

  • You are commercially minded, with an understanding of how strong positioning can drive pipeline, revenue, adoption and expansion.

  • You are an excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to create and present compelling ideas.

  • You are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting direction while also getting into the detail needed to make things happen.

  • You are creative and curious, willing to challenge conventional thinking and explore new ways to differentiate.

  • You have an analytical mindset and can use market research and performance data to support strategic decisions, with experience in ROI analysis and experimentation.

  • You have excellent project management skills and strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex initiatives from concept through to execution.

  • You have a growth mindset, bringing creativity, ambition and a proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.

💰 A competitive compensation package including stock options

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

We're looking for a Customer Marketing and Analyst Relations Manager to help tell the Constructor story to both industry analysts and our valued customers.

You'll create and run campaigns that ensure our customers know about our latest products and features as well as grow our customer advocacy program. You'll also manage our relationships with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and other tier-1 firms, driving everything from briefings and evaluations to an ongoing calendar of analyst engagement.

  • Exceptional storyteller who turns product capabilities into crisp, compelling stories

description_html:
About JetBrains Air

JetBrains has been building developer tools since 2000 — including IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin, TeamCity, and more, now trusted by 15M+ developers at 287K companies worldwide. The company is 100% private, profitable, and driven by a single thesis: great tools make developers better.

Air is what JetBrains is building next: an agentic development environment where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. It’s a genuinely new kind of developer tool — spanning a native desktop app, an expanding web experience, and cloud-based automations. It’s the next frontier after IDEs: not just helping developers write code, but helping them orchestrate it.

The Air design team is two people now — and you’d be the third. Your primary focus will be the web surface and the automations sub-team: an emerging part of the product that is ready for dedicated design ownership, with a real opportunity to raise the bar and shape the experience from the ground up.

What you’ll be working on

  • Design the web interface for Air: team management, automation setup, and a results overview

  • Shape the design process for the automations sub-team, working directly with developers to establish review and handoff practices

  • You decide what gets built. You turn a vague product direction into scope, a plan and a shipped surface, and you say no to the rest.

  • Own how the design system evolves across web and desktop: what belongs in it, what stays local, how two surfaces stay one product.

  • Vibe-code and use AI for prototyping when it helps move ideas forward faster

  • Participate in cross-team demos and quarterly planning, bringing a design perspective to where Air should go next

What you need

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with great examples of delivering results that impact the business.

  • Ownership instinct. You see features through from design to production. Delivery is part of your definition of done.

  • Excellent cross-team project delivery. You can work with limited context, clarify what matters, define the scope, and move projects forward across teams without needing constant hand-holding.

  • Active AI user. You use AI tools in your design workflow. You’ve experimented with building or prototyping with Cursor, Claude, or similar. This market moves weekly; you should too.

  • Solid Figma skills. Proficient with components, tokens/variables, and design systems — you can navigate an existing UI kit, understand how it works, and contribute new components as the product grows.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer-focused products or technical tooling (IDEs, dashboards, data tools)

  • Experience with vibe-coding, design engineering, or code-level prototypes

  • Familiarity with agentic or AI-native interface patterns — trust signals, human-in-the-loop, error handling at scale

What you get

  • Rare product scope. Work on a product that could define the next generation of developer tooling — small team, direct impact, decisions that ship fast.

  • JetBrains’ culture. Engineering-first, quality-focused, 100% private. No VC pressure, no artificial growth targets.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits — location-dependent, with a full breakdown available on request.

description_html:
At Applike Group, we don’t just "fill roles", we engineer the future of our high-growth portfolio companies. As a Talent Acquisition Partner dedicated to Sunday and justDice, your mission is to run tailored, highly targeted searches that acquire the exact Tech, Product, and Business talent needed to fuel their rapid growth.

This isn't a passive corporate recruiting seat. We expect you to be a deeply integrated, proactive business partner who understands the strategic trajectory of Sunday and justDice so well that you anticipate talent needs and map pipelines before a formal role is even opened. You will act as the engine that powers their scaling capabilities, combining a relentless hunter mindset with internal cross-functional collaboration.

Major Points of Impact:

  • 1. Tailored Growth Sourcing (Tech, Product & Business)

    You own the execution of bespoke talent acquisition strategies designed specifically for the unique, cross-functional roadmaps of Sunday and justDice.

    • Run highly customized, exhaustive searches across multiple platforms to identify and acquire niche technical profiles, product leaders, and commercial business talent.

    • Build and maintain continuous passive pipelines tailored to both the core engineering setups and commercial growth engines of your designated portfolio companies.

    • Focus heavily on outbound acquisition, treating every search like a dedicated mapping project to secure elite talent that inbound channels miss.

    2. Integrated Business Proactivity

    You don't wait for a job requisition to cross your desk; you are embedded in the rhythm of the business.

    • Partner closely with Engineering Leads, Product Directors, and Business Stakeholders to deeply understand their team dynamics, upcoming projects, and potential skills gaps.

    • Actively monitor team health and project roadmaps to propose proactive talent solutions, sourcing and validating great long-term fits without needing to be asked.

    • Transition smoothly from reacting to immediate hiring requests to executing strategic, situational talent mapping.

    3. Internal TA Ecosystem Collaboration

    You don't operate in a silo. You leverage the full power of our centralized TA specialized functions to maximize your output.

    • Partner seamlessly with our internal Talent Intelligence team to utilize market data, map competitor talent pools, and identify high-yield sourcing vectors.

    • Collaborate with TA Operations to optimize interview workflows, eliminate process bottlenecks, and ensure candidate data flows cleanly through our tool stack.

    • Act as the bridge connecting centralized data and operational support directly to the ground-level needs of Sunday and justDice.

Who you are:

  • Experience: 3-5+ years of relevant recruiting experience within high-growth environments. Alternatively, a strong recruitment agency background with a distinct passion for transitioning in-house.

  • Mindset: An exceptionally proactive, self-starting professional. You excel when integrated directly into a business unit, driven by an inherent passion to discover new talent. You exhibit strong agility while navigating complex, fluid, and high-stakes environments.

  • Sourcing & Collaboration: Outbound sourcing skills combined with a collaborative approach to partnering with internal Operations and Intelligence specialists.

  • Background: Experience in Talent Acquisition, Consulting, or Project Management is highly preferred to help navigate stakeholder landscapes.

  • Education: A university degree in Business, Social Sciences, or a related field would be advantageous.

  • Language(s): Professional fluency in English and ideally German.

  • Tech Stack & AI: High comfort level utilizing standard recruitment infrastructure and generative/agentic tools. Experience with Ashby, PeopleGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, Gemini or Claude, and Metaview is ideal.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to applike: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

The Interview Process:

  • 1st Interview with TA Manager

  • 2nd Head of Talent

  • Case Study

  • 3rd Case Study Presentation

  • 4th VP of People

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Strategy & Project Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Liqid Lig
description_html:
Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen. Du treibst High-Impact-Initiativen voran, behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick und trägst so unmittelbar zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von LIQID bei.

Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management und die verschiedensten Bereiche eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und direkten Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung von LIQID zu nehmen.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.


Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten.

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung: Du hast einen Blick auf alle relevanten KPIs, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und trägst dazu bei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu treffen. Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner.

  • Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden.

  • Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung.

  • Stakeholder Management: Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.

  • Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups).

  • Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern.

  • Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team: Ein entspannter erster Austausch, bei dem wir uns gegenseitig kennenlernen.

  • Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: Wir besprechen, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Rolle zu unseren Anforderungen passen.

  • Case Study: Wir möchten sehen, wie du komplexe Herausforderungen angehst und deine Problemlösungskompetenz anhand eines realistischen Arbeitsszenarios unter Beweis stellst.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du lernst das Team kennen und erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.


LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

description_html:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Client Experience & Engagement (f/m/d) you own everything that happens after a client's first investment. You design how human advice surfaces inside the app: contextual RM touchpoints, seamless handovers between self-service and personal consultation, and self-service flows for major actions (top-ups, strategy changes, tax documents) that reduce friction without reducing trust. You measure and improve the interplay between RM engagement and client outcomes, from retention to share of wallet.

You act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional squad of Engineering and Design, and prioritize with a transparent impact and effort logic that also means saying no.

What you bring

• Background: 7+ years of experience in Product Management for digital consumer products, ideally in FinTech, WealthTech, banking or another trust-driven domain. Experience with engagement, retention or CRM-driven product work is a strong plus, as is exposure to native app development.

• Analytical & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience with product analytics, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, and attribute impact credibly. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype and compress your own cycles.

• Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction) and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment. You understand that our clients entrust us with significant wealth and that every pixel of the experience either builds or erodes that trust.

• Communication & Language: Fluent in English (German a plus!), able to align Product, Design, Engineering, CRM and Relationship Management around one coherent client experience, and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership.

• Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid wealth experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.

title: Product Engineering Tech Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deepsetai
description_html:
TL;DR

We are hiring a Product Engineering Tech Lead to own the layer that runs our customers' AI applications: serverless, durable, streaming execution, and the observability that proves it works. You sit where backend engineering, platform operations, and product meet. You scale this platform to enterprise grade, push it into new territory like long running autonomous agents, lead the team that builds it, and own the result end to end. This is a builder role with a founder mindset, not a maintainer role.

Why deepset

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We’re remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You’ll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.

What you will do

  • Own the serverless execution platform. Pipelines and agents need to run fast, reliably, and concurrently at enterprise scale, and they need to behave identically whether invoked serverless or running as a deployed service. You'll architect the execution layer that makes that true, including the durability work (surviving node evictions, spot terminations, rolling deploys) needed to keep long-running agents alive for hours, not seconds.

  • Own streaming and long-lived connections. Conversational and agentic workloads here are long-lived, not simple request/responses. You'll own how those connections behave under pressure: backpressure, graceful shutdown, reconnects, for both end users and API clients.

  • Lead the team and the architecture. Set technical direction, make the hard tradeoffs, and translate product strategy into a system that holds up under enterprise load. You stay hands-on on the problems that matter most, even as your day-to-day coding share shifts over time.

  • Make reliability provable. Own observability and metering: tracing, alerting, per-customer cost and usage visibility, so the platform's reliability isn't just a claim, it's something you can show a customer. You'll also own on-call and incident response, closing the loop between what you build and what you operate.

What you bring to the team

  • Builder and founder mindset. You have started things, shipped them, and lived with the consequences. You think about what is next, not only about fixing what is in front of you. Startup or founder experience is a strong signal here.

  • You have built and operated systems on Kubernetes in production, and you are comfortable working from the ground up. This role is not about owning one slice of an existing system, or only operating infrastructure someone else designed. It is product work: building something new and owning the outcome.

  • Durable execution experience. You have worked with durable, fault tolerant execution: retries, failover, durable state, and human in the loop. You understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.

  • Serverless and function platforms at scale. Knative, KEDA, OpenFaaS, Fission, or similar. You know scale to zero, warm pools, cold start tradeoffs, and per request isolation.

  • Streaming and long running workloads. Server sent events or websockets, long lived connections, and the operational reality of keeping them alive through deploys and node churn. Agentic or AI workloads are a plus.

  • Operator instinct. Observability, alerting, service levels, and incident response are second nature. You hold the platform to a production grade standard because it has to work reliably for real customers.

  • You can lead a team and connect strategy to robust architecture. You make the technical direction legible to the rest of the team and to the business.

  • Comfortable in Python and with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) in a cloud native stack.

Nice to have

  • Built Kubernetes operators or controllers, or automated deployments as a system rather than a script.

  • Taken a platform from zero to one all the way to production grade ownership.

  • Open source contribution or maintenance background.

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS, LLM, or agent infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice

  • 30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave

  • Competitive salary & stock options for every team member

  • Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Monthly team socials & in-person meetups

  • Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

description_html:
What is working at Bettermile like?

  • We mean it when we say “cutting edge” and have a high level of creative freedom in our everyday work

  • You will be surrounded by like-minded, driven, skilled, and highly motivated people who are keen to contribute to successful solutions

  • We mean diversity, and we put it in numbers: 130+ people, 40 languages, 40% female (vs. ø26% in the tech industry), ø33 years of age, and yes, we do have Schlager-Fans among us

  • We have a very supportive and appreciative working environment with a lot of autonomy, a flat hierarchy, and professional growth possibilities

  • We work in a hybrid mode, with weekly team days for better collaboration and nurturing interpersonal connections. When onsite, we work in a modern, kid- and pet-friendly Better Space in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • Remote work from anywhere for up to 12 weeks in total per year

  • 30 vacation days in a 5-day/week working model

  • Kindergarten grant and a Company Pension scheme

  • Regular team breakfasts, fitness & wellness classes, company runs, and other events. Fruits, snacks, drinks, and coffee with a variety of milk are a given - but yes, we have them

  • Outstanding flexibility we are proud of – and, of course, the best colleagues in the world!

About Better Planner Tribe:

Better Planner is the newest product in the Bettermile suite, built to redefine how logistics operations plan, predict, and execute. Depot mornings determine cost, productivity, and delivery performance for the entire day. Better Planner uses AI powered planning models and delivery patterns to design balanced routes, define clear loading zones, and prepare dispatch teams before operations begin.

With structured loading logic and parcels pre assigned to drivers, sorting is faster, loading is smoother, and drivers spend more time delivering instead of waiting in the depot.

You will be taking care of

  • Architect, improve, and implement data pipelines for BetterPlanner while reaching for durable execution

  • Supply the ML models with correct, timely and clean data

  • Keep track and monitor pipelines to identify quality issues

  • Support software developers and data analysts with new data points or expansion to new countries

  • Work together with the other data engineers and analysts from other teams to improve the shared data platform

  • Coordinate and devise action plans to support the growth of the company as a whole

  • Provide technical mentorship of the whole tribe in terms of latest technologies, best practices

You check these boxes

  • Highly skilled in Python and SQL, with proven experience working with Snowflake

  • Experienced with big data manipulation and ingestion tools like dbt, Fivetran, or similar technologies

  • Know your way around job orchestrators, with a strong preference for Dagster.

  • You’re naturally curious, highly adaptable, and thrive on tackling complex problem-solving challenges

  • You excel at stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration, meaning you love working in a team environment and easily translate complex technical concepts for non-technical business partners

  • Bring a customer-centric mindset, always designing and building data solutions with the ultimate end-user in mind

  • Fluent in the English language written and spoken, German is not required

It is awesome if you also have

  • Solid knowledge of AWS, especially services like RDS, S3, Firehose, and queue-based ingestion systems like SQS or event buses

  • Experience handling and visualizing geospatial data effectively

  • Some exposure to MLOps, specifically hosting, inference, and running training jobs for machine learning models

Take your chance

Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing, and quick decision-making that moves things forward.

Currently, we’re proceeding only with candidates authorized to work in Germany or who already hold a Job Seeker Visa.

About us

At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.

Our geo-based, AI-powered SaaS product handles complex address processing, dynamic routing, and navigation. It is built to manage many stops and multiple constraints.

We’re setting a new standard for the last mile and pushing the industry forward, powered by a skilled, international team of tech enthusiasts, logistics experts, and a product suite designed to keep evolving.

title: Account Executive - Berlin
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tebi
description_html:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path


What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

 

Mistral AI is seeking a Applied AI Engineer to facilitate the adoption of its products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges.

 

The Applied AI team is Mistral's customer-facing technical organization. We work directly with enterprise clients from pre-sales through implementation to deploy cutting-edge AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

 

Our team combines deep ML expertise with strong customer engagement skills, operating like startup CTOs who own end-to-end project execution. By joining the team you'll will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world enterprise applications, ensuring our solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Mistral's technological vision.

 

What you will do

 

- You’ll individually help deploy into production use cases with a considerable business impact across various industries.

- You’ll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications from consumer products to industrial use cases, driving with our customers a crucial technological transformation.

- You’ll work in collaboration with our researchers, other AI engineers, product engineers on our most complex customer projects involving complex fine-tuning, state-of-the-art LLM applications, and contributing to our open-source codebases our open source codebases for tasks such as inference and fine-tuning.

- You’ll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential clients' needs, challenges, and aspirations. You will provide technical guidance on our products and explain Mistral technologies to various stakeholders.

- Your collaboration with our product and science team to improve continuously our product and model capabilities based on customers’ feedback

 

How We Work in Applied AI

 

- We care about people and outputs.

- What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

- Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

- Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

- We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

- No politics. Low ego, high standards.

- We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

 

About you

 

- You are fluent in English

- You have 2+ years as a technical individual contributor (data scientist or software engineer) on AI-based products

- You have proven experience in AI or machine learning product implementation with APIs, back-end and front-end interfaces.

- You have experience in Fine Tuning LLMs, tackling advanced RAG or agentic use cases

- You have deep understanding of concepts and algorithms underlying machine learning and LLMs

- You have strong technical coding skills in Python

- You hold strong communication skills with an ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms with technical and non-technical audiences

 

Ideally you have:

- Contributed to open-source projects in particular in the space of LLMs

- Experience as a Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or Technical Product Manager

- You have experience with deep learning with Pytorch

Why join us?

 

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI adoption in enterprises, work with a world-class team, and contribute to open-source projects that impact millions. If you’re excited about leading technical innovation and solving real-world challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

 

By applying, you agree to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Werkstudent:in Content & Social Media (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at OK ROGER Consulting UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
description_html:
Worum es geht

Wir sind OK ROGER. Im Kern eine Markenberatung: Unsere Kunden können etwas — nur sieht man es ihnen oft nicht an. Zwischen dem, was sie sind, und dem, was ankommt, liegt Rauschen. Wir räumen es weg.

Aber Markenberatung ist nur eine Sparte. Wir wachsen gerade stark und unternehmerisch, in mehrere Richtungen gleichzeitig. Für dich heißt das: Du steigst über einen klaren Bereich ein — und bleibst nicht darauf beschränkt.

Dein Einstieg ist die Content-Produktion für unsere Social-Media-Kunden. Das ist der Anfang, nicht die Decke. Weil wir wachsen, wächst die Rolle mit — in mehr Verantwortung, in neue Bereiche, so weit du willst.

Was du bei uns machst

Dein Einstieg: Content für unsere Kunden.

  • Du produzierst Content: Redaktionsplanung, Grafik und Text, fertige Posts — mit eigener Handschrift.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen mit. Formate, Aufhänger, Posts — nicht nur Umsetzung, sondern Einfälle.

  • Am Anfang arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite. Nach dem Onboarding übernimmst du eigene Kunden — du planst, produzierst und verantwortest ihren Auftritt, wir schauen nur noch an den richtigen Stellen drauf.

  • Du holst Freigaben bei Kunden ein und stimmst Operatives ab. Die Kundenbeziehung selbst bleibt bei uns.

  • Du hältst die Qualität, auch im Detail. Bei uns liest der Markt Sorgfalt als Substanz.

Dein Blick über den Tellerrand.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns zusammen und bekommst Einblick, wo andere Werkstudierende nie hinkommen: wie eine Beratung geführt wird, wie Entscheidungen fallen, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird.

  • Konkret packst du beim Aufbau eines weiteren unternehmerischen Projekts mit an, das wir gerade hochziehen.

  • Ja, manches davon ist Organisieren und Mitdenken im Alltag. Aber nichts davon ist Beschäftigung — jede Aufgabe zeigt dir ein Stück davon, wie Unternehmen entstehen.

So fängst du an — und wohin es gehen kann

Wir werfen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser. Die ersten Wochen arbeitest du eng an unserer Seite und lernst, wie wir arbeiten. Danach wirst du Schritt für Schritt eigenständiger. Und dann? Bei uns führt kein einziger Weg nach oben, sondern mehrere nach vorne:

  • Tiefer in den Content. Von einzelnen Posts zu eigenen Kunden, die du verantwortest.

  • Breiter ins Unternehmen. Mit in ein weiteres Vorhaben, mit in Bereiche, die gerade erst entstehen.

  • Mehr Verantwortung. Wer zeigt, dass er trägt, bekommt mehr zu tragen.

  • Langfristig. Passt es für beide, wächst die Rolle über das Studium hinaus. Kein Versprechen in einer Anzeige — aber eine echte Möglichkeit, wenn du Lust hast.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast eigene Ideen und Lust, mitzuwachsen. Du willst nicht nur abarbeiten, sondern dazulernen.

  • Du bist auf den gängigen Social-Media-Plattformen zuhause — du weißt, was gerade funktioniert und warum.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit den gängigen Tools — Canva und/oder Adobe, CapCut, Meta Business Suite oder vergleichbaren Planungstools.

  • Du textest und gestaltest sicher genug, dass ein Post ohne uns fertig wird. Profi in beidem musst du nicht sein — den Rest schärfen wir gemeinsam.

  • Du hast Haltung und Empathie — du spürst, was ein Mensch oder eine Marke eigentlich sagen will.

  • Du bist verlässlich und genau. Wenn du sagst, etwas ist fertig, ist es fertig.

  • Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, digitale Medien, Medienwissenschaften, Design o. Ä.

  • Du schreibst und sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau.

Was du nicht brauchst

  • Kein Portfolio mit fünf Jahren Agentenerfahrung.

  • Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist, dass du es lernen willst.

  • Keinen geraden Lebenslauf. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst — nicht, ob bisher alles glattlief.

Was du bekommst

Das ist keine Kaffeeholen-Stelle mit Zeugniszeile am Ende. Du nimmst mit:

  • Echte Projekte, echte Marken. Du übst nicht an erfundenen Fällen — du arbeitest an Kunden, die es wirklich gibt, und siehst, was deine Arbeit bei ihnen auslöst.

  • Ein Netzwerk, das dir sonst verschlossen bliebe. Wir kennen viele Menschen — Gründer:innen, Unternehmer:innen, Entscheider:innen. Bei uns lernst du sie kennen.

  • Unternehmertum von innen. Bei einem Projekt, das gerade entsteht, siehst du zu, wie aus einer Idee ein Unternehmen wird — die Entscheidungen, nicht nur die Ergebnisse. Das lernt man in keinem Seminar.

  • Kurze Wege. Du fragst uns direkt, nicht drei Ebenen hoch. Feedback ehrlich, Entscheidungen schnell.

  • 17 € pro Stunde.

So sieht dein Rahmen aus

Du startest mit mindestens 10 Stunden pro Woche. Passt es — für dich und für uns —, können wir auf bis zu 20 Stunden aufstöcken. Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und flexibel um dein Studium herum. Zum Zusammenarbeiten haben wir einen Tisch im Coworking-Space SpaceDus auf der Moltkestraße — da kommen wir zusammen, wenn es hilft.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Motivationsschreiben. Schick uns stattdessen:

  • kurz, wer du bist, und wo (Studium, ab wann, wie viele Stunden),

  • ein, zwei Sachen, die du gemacht hast (Post, Grafik, Text — egal wie klein),

  • und eine Antwort auf diese Frage: Zeig uns einen Auftritt — eine Marke, ein Mensch, ein Produkt — der besser ist als sein Bild. Was würdest du in einem einzigen Post daran ändern?

description_html:
Strong organic search performance depends on consistent research, monitoring and testing. For the French market, that means understanding how people search, how competitors appear in search results and where content can perform better. At idealo, you will support our France SEO work with research, reporting and hands-on optimisation tasks while learning SEO through real projects. You will work closely with an experienced SEO manager and contribute to projects around Google Search, content and emerging search technologies. When your research helps uncover an optimisation opportunity, you can see how your work feeds directly into improvements on idealo.fr.

About your new role

  • Monitor SEO performance and support recurring reporting for idealo.fr.

  • Research competitors, search results and developments in the French market.

  • Support keyword research, content optimisation and SEO testing.

  • Prepare analyses for important French commercial and sales events.

  • Keep SEO documentation, meeting notes and project follow-ups up to date.


Skills & Requirements

Must-have

  • You are currently studying marketing, business, digital or a related field.

  • You speak French fluently and communicate confidently in English.

  • You are comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and online research.

  • You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.

Nice-to-have

  • You enjoy tackling challenges actively and solving them pragmatically.

 

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

title: PreSales Solution Architect (Azure) (m/w/d)

description_html:
Du verstehst Kundenanforderungen nicht nur technisch, sondern denkst sie konsequent bis in den Betrieb zu Ende?
Als PreSales Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Azure-basierte Managed-Services-Lösungen. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass diese von Anfang an sauber in unser Betriebsmodell überführt werden können und agierst als technisches Bindeglied zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.

Was du bei uns machst
  • Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen im PreSales-Prozess und übersetzt sie in passende Managed-Service-Lösungen auf Basis von Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten.
  • Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Service-Operations-Teams das konkrete Betriebsmodell für neue Kundenlösungen: inklusive Betriebsverantwortung, SLAs, Automatisierungsgrad und Schnittstellen.
  • Du erstellst technische Lösungskonzepte, Aufwandsschätzungen und Betriebsannahmen als Grundlage für Angebote und Business Cases.
  • Du begleitest Kundengespräche und Workshops, moderierst technische Anforderungsklärung und präsentierst Lösungsvorschläge verständlich auf Entscheiderebene.
  • Du sorgst für eine strukturierte Übergabe von PreSales an Delivery und Operations.
  • Du bringst dich aktiv in Weiterentwicklung unseres Managed-Services-Portfolios ein.
  • Du berätst Kunden zu Sicherheit, Skalierung, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebskosten ihrer Azure-Umgebungen im Kontext eines Managed-Service-Betriebs.

    • Wann du zu uns passt
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Architekturdesign mit Azure PaaS-, IaaS- und Container-Diensten und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Betrieb solcher Umgebungen mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in technische Architekturen sowie in Betriebsmodelle und Servicekonzepte.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung zu Azure-Diensten hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Sicherheit, Skalierung und Betriebszeit mit.
  • Du bist mit den Grundlagen von Managed Services wie SLAs, Betriebsprozessen, Serviceleveln, Automatisierung und ITSM vertraut.
  • Du bist mit Azure DevOps, automatisierten Pipelines und Infrastructure as Code sowie deren Bedeutung für einen standardisierten Betrieb vertraut.
  • Du bist in der Lage, technische PreSales-Meetings zu leiten und Lösungen verständlich gegenüber Kunden und intern zu präsentieren.
  • Du verstehst dich als Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.
  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und kannst sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.
    • Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
    Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
     

    Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

    Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

    Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

    Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig.
