description_html:
MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Sammle Praxiserfahrung in Finance & Digitalisierung – mitten in der Prozessautomatisierung
 
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen endlich in der Praxis anwenden? Du interessierst dich für Daten, digitale Prozesse und Automatisierung, arbeitest strukturiert und möchtest Teil eines motivierten Teams werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team im Bereich Commissions im operativen Tagesgeschäft und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Dabei arbeitest du mit Daten, unterstützt bei bestehenden Prozessen und lernst moderne Technologien und Schnittstellen kennen.
 
Das erwartet dich
 
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team bei der Durchführung, Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Prozesse im Finanzbereich. Dabei übernimmst du klar definierte Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest an kleineren Daten- und Automatisierungsthemen mit.
 
Unter anderem unterstützt du bei:
 

  • Pflege und Überwachung bestehender ETL-Prozesse sowie automatisierter Abläufe
  • Durchführung von Datenvalidierungen, Tests und Qualitätsprüfungen
  • Unterstützung bei Monatsabschlussprozessen und Ad-hoc-Anfragen
  • Mitarbeit an Automatisierungen mit Python, SQL und REST-APIs
  • Aufbereitung von Reports und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen
 
Das bringst du mit
 
  • Laufendes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie Interesse an Python und Prozessautomatisierung
  • Verständnis für Datenstrukturen und Schnittstellen zwischen Systemen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Teamgeist und Freude daran, Neues zu lernen
 
Berufserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und dein Interesse an Daten und digitalen Prozessen.
 
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche, passend zu deinem Studium
  • Freie Verteilung deiner Arbeitszeit – zum Beispiel zwei volle Tage und ein halber Tag oder ganz nach Absprache
  • Praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, SQL und modernen Datenprozessen
  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten
  • Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie persönliche Betreuung
 
 Deine Entwicklung
 
  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in die Digitalisierung von Finanzprozessen
  • Aufbau von Kenntnissen in SQL, Python und ETL-Prozessen
  • Mitarbeit an Daten- und Automatisierungsprojekten
  • Persönliche Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • Wertvolle Berufserfahrung für deinen Karriereweg
 
Arbeiten bei ecotel
 
  • Duz-Kultur auf allen Ebenen
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Karneval
  • Modern ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze
  • Firmenlaptop und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fitnessraum am Standort Düsseldorf
  • Kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst
  • Kostenfreie Parkplätze in unserer Tiefgarage
  • Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung
  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie bezahlter Sonderurlaub bei besonderen persönlichen Ereignissen
  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
 
Attraktive Vergütung

 
  • 1.350 € brutto pro Monat bei einer 20-Stunden-Woche 
 
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
 
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 
Bitte sende uns folgende Unterlagen:
 
  • deinen Lebenslauf
  • deine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  • optional ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem wir erfahren, warum du unser Team unterstützen möchtest
 
Vielfalt ist für uns selbstverständlich. Alter, Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Religion oder eine Behinderung spielen für uns keine Rolle – wir freuen uns auf Menschen mit Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Begeisterung für Digitalisierung.
 
Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – #readyfordigitalbusiness.
 
Dein Ansprechpartner: Dominic Schillers

description_html:
MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Bring IT zum Laufen
 
Du interessierst dich für IT, Netzwerke, Hardware und moderne Technologien? Du möchtest verstehen, wie Unternehmen sicher und zuverlässig arbeiten können und dabei selbst an modernen IT-Lösungen mitwirken? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du, wie moderne IT-Infrastrukturen aufgebaut, betreut und weiterentwickelt werden. Du unterstützt unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei technischen Fragestellungen, arbeitest an spannenden IT-Projekten mit und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Team dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig funktionieren.
 
Egal, ob du gerade die Schule abschließt oder gemerkt hast, dass ein Studium doch nicht der richtige Weg für dich ist – wir freuen uns auf motivierte Talente, die Lust haben, etwas zu bewegen.

Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du unsere IT aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven kennen. Du arbeitest von Anfang an aktiv im Tagesgeschäft sowie an spannenden IT-Projekten mit und erlebst, wie moderne IT-Systeme den Arbeitsalltag eines Unternehmens zuverlässig und sicher unterstützen.
 
Unter anderem lernst du:
 

  • wie IT-Arbeitsplätze, Notebooks und Endgeräte eingerichtet, konfiguriert und betreut werden

  • IT

  • Rechenzentrum
  • Security Management
  • Consulting
So lernst du die technische Seite unseres Unternehmens kennen und verstehst gleichzeitig, wie IT, Fachbereiche und Kunden erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten.

  • Moderne Technologien rund um Cloud, Netzwerke, Virtualisierung und Telekommunikation
  • Früh Verantwortung übernehmen und deine eigenen Ideen einbringen.
  • Ein motiviertes Ausbildungsteam, das dich auf deinem gesamten Weg begleitet.

  • Begeisterung für IT, Computer, Netzwerke und neue Technologien
  • Spaß daran, technische Probleme zu analysieren und Lösungen zu finden
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Teamgeist
  • Neugier auf neue Technologien und Motivation, dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche

  • Möglichkeit zur Ausbildungsverkürzung bei sehr guten Leistungen
  • Übernahmequote von über 85 %

title: (SENIOR) Relationship & Recruiting Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Synsero
description_html:
Kurzbeschreibung

Du liebst es, Menschen und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammenzubringen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Als (Senior) Relationship & Recruiting Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Besetzung anspruchsvoller Fach- und Projektpositionen im Industrie- und Energiesektor. Dabei begleitest Du Freelancer von der ersten Ansprache bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung und arbeitest eng mit unserem Account Management zusammen.
Mit Deinem Gespür für Menschen, Deinem Blick auf den Markt und Deiner Leidenschaft für Recruiting identifizierst Du die besten Experten, führst Interviews, entwickelst nachhaltige Talentpools und berätst Kunden sowie Kandidaten als vertrauensvoller Ansprechpartner. Gleichzeitig bringst Du eigene Ideen ein, optimierst Prozesse und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum unseres Geschäfts bei.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess zur Besetzung spannender, nationaler und internationaler Positionen in Unternehmensübergreifenden Bereichen – von Projektmanagern, über SAP und PLM Spezialisten, bis hin zu Engineering Rollen – und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Account Management im 180°- Modell zusammen.
  • Du beobachtest den aktuellen Kandidatenmarkt und trittst bei unseren Kunden und Beratern als Experte rund um das Thema Recruiting auf.
  • Du gehst auf unterschiedlichen Businessportalen aktiv auf die Suche nach Experten, pitchst die zu besetzende Position und begeisterst potenzielle Kandidaten für uns und unsere Kunden.
  • Du analysierst CV´s und führst Interviews, um einen optimalen Fit sicherzustellen und die beste Vorauswahl für Deine Projekte zu treffen.
  • Du begleitest deine Experten entlang des gesamten Besetzungsprozesses vom Erstkontakt bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung, verhandelst Konditionen und stehst beratend zur Seite.
  • Du sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare und gute Struktur in unserem CRM und baust den Kandidatenpool weiter aus
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen und betreust mehrere Großkunden


Dein Profil

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Berufserfahrungen im Recruiting von bereichsübergreifenden Positionen im Industrie und Energiesektor oder verwandten Berufsfeldern und kennst die Personaldienstleistungsbranche.
  • Du kannst erste Erfolge in der Entwicklung effektiver Recruitingstrategien nachweisen und verstehst es, eine Kandidatenpipeline aufzubauen.
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen Tools und bist bereit, neue Wege zu gehen, um die besten Experten zu finden.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Datenmanagement von CRM Daten.
  • Du hast eine Leidenschaft für das Peoplebusiness, gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu und hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mute Labs Gmbh
description_html:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

description_html:
Your mission

Cloud Native Node.js & AI-enabled Product with SAP Private Cloud Integration | Senior / Principal Level 

As Senior Technical Architect – Hybrid, you own the technical design across our two worlds: the cloud-native, AI-enabled product line built on modern Node.js architectures, and its integration into the SAP Private Cloud platform landscape. 
Your focus is approximately 70% Public Cloud product architecture and 30% SAP Private Cloud platform architecture. You are the architect who makes the hybrid seam work – ensuring that public cloud innovation and the SAP core evolve as one coherent, scalable, and future-proof landscape rather than two disconnected estates. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Cloud-Native Product Architecture (Primary Focus)
Design of microservices architectures on Node.js 
API-first and event-driven architecture concepts 
Definition of service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns 
Ensuring multi-tenant capability and tenant isolation 
Non-functional design: performance, scalability, resilience, cost 
  • AI Integration in Product
Technical architecture for AI features in the product 
Integration of LLMs or AI services within defined guardrails 
Design of RAG and agentic patterns over product and platform data 
Performance and cost optimization of AI-driven features 
  • Hybrid Integration Architecture (Public ↔ Private Cloud)
Design of the integration layer between cloud-native products and SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud 
API and event contracts across the hybrid boundary (OData, REST, SAP Business Events, Event Mesh) 
Data ownership, consistency, and synchronisation patterns across both estates 
Identity, authorisation, and trust propagation across the hybrid landscape 
  • SAP Private Cloud Platform Architecture (Secondary Focus)
Architectural guidance for S/4HANA Private Cloud extensions and side-by-side scenarios 
Enforcement of clean core principles and SAP development standards 
Architectural review of SAP-side designs together with the SAP Private Cloud & SCM architect 
Awareness of core SCM process flows (SD, MM, EWM) as they surface into product capabilities 
  • DevOps & Deployment Architecture
Collaboration with infrastructure and deployment engineers across both estates 
Architecture design for containerization and cloud deployment 
CI/CD and environment strategy spanning public and private cloud pipelines 
  • Design Governance
Creation of HLD, SDD, and TDD up to epic level 
Technical review and sign-off responsibility in the Architecture Board 
Translation of enterprise guardrails into actionable design standards for teams 

Organizational Context 

  • Embedded in the Engineering function
  • Senior / Principal Level
  • Part of the Architecture Board
  • Operates within guardrails defined by the Enterprise Architect
  • Works in close tandem with the Technical Architect – Public Cloud and the Technical Architect – SAP Private Cloud & SCM


Your profile

  • Several years of experience as an architect in cloud-native environments
  • Strongexpertisein Node.js
  • Experience with microservices and API architectures
  • Strong understanding of event-driven systems
  • Experience integrating AI into software products
  • Cloud architecture experience (containers, orchestration, scaling)
  • Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and clean core extension patterns
  • Proventrack recorddesigning integration between cloud-native applications and an ERP core
  • High technical credibility with senior engineers in both cloud-native and SAP teamsPlus 
  • Experience with SAP BTP and SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS)
  • Experience with RISE with SAP orhyperscaler-hosted SAP environments
  • Exposure to SCM processes and SAP modules (SD, MM, EWM)
  • Experience with ABAP / RAP at review levelechnology Stack 
  • Public Cloud & Product (≈70%)
Node.js, TypeScript, microservices, API-first design 
Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes / Kyma), Cloud Foundry 
Event-Driven Architecture, SAP Event Mesh, SAP Business Events 
CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability 
  • SAP Platform & Extensions (≈30%)
SAP BTP, SAP CAP (Node.js/CDS) 
S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud side-by-side extensions 
Clean Core OData APIs, ABAP / RAP (at review level) 
  • Data & AI
HANA Cloud (HDI, Vector Engine) 
Generative AI / SAP AI Core, RAG, LLM integration 
LangChain / LangGraph, agentic orchestration 
  • Infrastructure & Security
Multi-Tenant Architecture 
XSUAA / IAS / IPS, identity federation across hybrid landscapes 
CI/CD (SAP and non-SAP toolchains) 

AI Readiness 

We expect our architects to work with AI, not just design for it. We assess AI readiness on two levels. 
  • General AI Working Practice
Habitual, critical use of AI assistants in daily engineering and design work 
Ability to judge where AI output is trustworthy and where it must be verified 
Awareness of data protection, IP, and confidentiality boundaries when using AI tools 
Willingness to share prompts, patterns, and lessons learned with the wider engineering organisation 
  • Role-Specific AI Usage
AI-assisted architecture work: option analysis, trade-off exploration, design review support 
AI-assisted generation and maintenance of HLD, SDD, and TDD artefacts 
Use of AI coding assistants for prototypes, spikes, and reference implementations 
Designing AI-native product capabilities: RAG over product and SAP data, agentic workflows, guardrails and evaluation 
Assessing AI features for cost, latency, and operational risk before they enter the architecture


Why us?

You hold the hybrid landscape together. You build the foundation for scalable public cloud products, enable AI-native capabilities and ensure the SAP core and cloud-native product portfolio evolve as one. Your role enables innovation to scale at pace while keeping the platform stable, governed, and coherent.

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Implico Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Working Student (m/f/d)​Indexing Platform
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Solactive
description_html:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
  • Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
  • Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
  • Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family  an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
  • Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
  • Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
  • Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.


Your Application

This role sounds like you? Then we look forward to receiving your application.  Please make sure to also upload your CV, a cover letter is not compulsory. If you have any futher questions just drop us an email! Sonia Urusaro -  
No artificial intelligence (AI) is used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position. 
Solactive does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process and will never request payment for CV enhancement, interviews, training, equipment, or other recruitment-related services. Please be cautious of fake profiles or fraudulent messages claiming to represent Solactive. If you are unsure whether a communication is legitimate, contact us at

You're excited about financial markets and instruments like ETFs, bonds, and swaps. You enjoy programming and building software on a modern tech stack, and love a good discussion on technical design.   • Integrate with Apache Kafka and GCP Pub/Sub for event-driven data flows;consume, transform, and cache data from upstream data points in a reliable andrecoverable manner.
  • Build and maintain public APIs and automated document delivery pipelines (pushto customer servers, on-demand retrieval).
  • Contribute to the document rendering architecture, keeping it extensible for bothstandard and custom, client-specific documents, and actively pushing documentsout rather than only exposing them passively.
  • Develop the internal frontend tooling required by the team and its products; helpdefine the frontend stack as the team evolves.
  • Write SQL and work with relational databases, including query optimization and schema design for reporting workloads.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and contribute to DevOps practices within the team.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, promote engineering best practices, andcontribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements intoreliable technical solutions, and explain complex technical trade-offs back to themin plain language

Must Have

    or Azure); cloud-agnostic mindset, ability to transfer skills across providers.
    Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational databases.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Practical fullstack ability: comfortable building internal tooling / lightweight
    frontends; frontend framework can be defined together with the team.
  • Track record of designing scalable, resilient systems and taking features from
    concept to production.
  • A proactive mindset: you spot gaps and opportunities before they're handed to
    you, and you act on them.
  • A strong drive for teamwork: you collaborate across functions, share context
    generously, and lift the people around you rather than optimizing solo.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and
    make trade-offs legible to the business
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, mentoring mindset.
Nice to have
  • Experience with GCP in particular (Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage / buckets).
  • Working knowledge of Python (the team has Python components).
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript.
  • Experience with document generation / rendering pipelines (PDF, XLS/CSV,
    templated reports).
  • Familiarity with the financial domain, index data, or reporting for financial
    institutions and regulatory bodies.
  • Experience designing and exposing public APIs for external clients

title: Senior Product Engineer - Android/Kotlin

description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

➡️ Mission

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. You'll own product-critical features end-to-end — from technical design to rollout — in a large, modular Kotlin codebase where craft and velocity both matter. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Frontend.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end-to-end: You'll take ownership from discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and iteration on features that help businesses pay, get paid, and stay in control.
  • Drive technical decisions in your squad: You'll shape solutions with Product, Design, and Backend by clarifying tradeoffs across UX, performance, security, and time-to-market.
  • Raise app reliability and maintainability: You'll improve architecture, performance, and test strategy to scale the app without compromising stability.
  • Tackle complex mobile challenges: You'll contribute to real-time synchronization, resilience patterns, and smooth navigation in a modular codebase with ~1,000 modules.
  • Grow the team's Android craft: You'll lead code reviews and technical discussions, share patterns, and mentor peers to raise the bar on quality and delivery.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Strong Android native experience: You've shipped and maintained production features with Kotlin and are comfortable owning technical decisions end-to-end.
  • Quality-driven mindset: You care about testing (unit, UI, snapshot), clean code, and pragmatic standards that keep teams moving fast.
  • Problem-solving approach: You thrive in ambiguity and turn complex constraints into simple, robust solutions.
  • AI-native workflow: You use AI coding tools daily to amplify your output — not just experiment with them.
  • Collaborative by nature: You're fluent in English and contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • An AI-first engineering environment: Unlimited access to Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot — and a culture that expects you to use them to raise the bar, not just go faster (click here to read our vision statement on AI)
  • Engineering standards that scale: Strong code review culture, continuous refactoring, and a focus on correctness in a regulated context.
  • A technically demanding domain: Fintech constraints — security, compliance, real-time data — push you to solve problems most mobile engineers never encounter.

➡️ Our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.
  • Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates.
  • Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager.
Want to go further? Click here

➡️ Our stack & practices

  • Kotlin-first & modern concurrency: 100% Kotlin codebase with Coroutines + Flow throughout.
  • Architecture: MVVM + Clean Architecture with modular design (~1000 modules).
  • UI direction: New screens built with Jetpack Compose, with a large share of legacy views already migrated.
  • CI/CD & quality: GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, Fastlane.
  • Testing culture: 26k+ unit tests, 14k+ snapshot tests, 500+ UI tests.

Curious about how we tackle tech debt? Check out our talk from the last Droidcon here featuring Florian.

➡️ Your future team

As an Android Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organised around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140+ mobile engineering community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

title: Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Odoo DE GmbH
description_html:
Du begeisterst dich für Technologie, suchst einen Job, der unfassbar abwechslungsreich ist, du mit verschiedenen Menschen in Kontakt treten kannst und dir tiefe Einblicke in zahlreiche Unternehmen und Branchen bietet.

Deine Mission? Die Digitalsierung voranzutreiben. In dieser Position treibst du das Wachstum durch proaktive Outbound-Aktivitäten voran, generierst neue Leads und schaffst Nachfrage auf dem DACH-Markt. 🚀

Aufgaben

Wie dein Alltag aussehen wird?

Tja, gar nicht so leicht zu beantworten, denn deine Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich und immer unterschiedlich. Aber in der Regel wirst du die Möglichkeit haben, unsere Strategie zur Lead-Generierung mitzugestalten, jeden Monat Zielbranchen auszuwählen und unsere Outreach-Aktivitäten voranzutreiben.

  • Lead-Generierung: Recherche und Identifikation von potenziellen Kunden über verschiedene Kanäle wie bsp. Online-Recherchen.
  • Nutzung verschiedener Tools und Techniken zur Kundenakquise, um eine Pipeline mit qualifizierten Leads aufzubauen.
  • Sales Cycle vollumfänglich managen: Du übernimmst das Cold Calling, das Versenden von E-Mails und anderen Kommunikationsmethoden, um mit potenziellen Kunden in Kontakt zu treten, um deren Geschäftsanforderungen und -prozesse zu analysieren und zu qualifizieren.
  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung von maßgeschneiderten Produktdemos.
  • Verhandlung von Verträgen und Abschlüssen mit deinen Kunden.
  • Du wirst zu deinen Kunden enge Beziehungen aufbauen und deren Vertrauen gewinnen.
  • Teilnahme an Networking-Veranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Messen, um dein Kundennetzwerk aufzubauen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam, um weitere Wachstumspotenziale herauszuarbeiten.
  • Bitte beachte, dass diese Position in Berlin angesiedelt ist.

Qualifikation

Über dich:

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.
Das erwarten wir von dir:

  • Erste Arbeitserfahrungen als SDR oder auf einer vergleichbaren Position im Sales sind wünschenswert.
  • Einen stark ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und ein hohes Maß an Neugierde.
  • Resilienz & eine Get-it-Done Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, analytisch Probleme zu lösen.
  • Interesse, sich in eine Software und die SaaS-Welt einzuarbeiten.
  • Sehr starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Sprachen Deutsch & Englisch (C1-C2)
  • Die Fähigkeit, Vertrauen und Enthusiasmus zu schaffen.
  • Einen Bachelor/Master Abschluss oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

Bei Odoo setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, inklusives und authentisches Arbeitsumfeld ein. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller oder Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen.Du hast Lust auf die Stelle, aber dein Profil passt nicht zu 100%? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person diesen Job!

Benefits

Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen

Das bietet dir Odoo

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.
  • Sachbezug : Erhalte monatlich 50€ zum Shoppen bei zahlreichen Geschäften, Restaurants und Tankstellen.
  • Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.
  • Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.
  • Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.
  • Go Global - Austauschprogramm : Lust auf Auslandserfahrung? Nach 2 Jahren Odoo hast du die Möglichkeit dich an einen unserer weltweiten Standorte versetzen zu lassen.

Recruiting Prozess

01 Bewerbungsscreening

Wir checken deine Bewerbung um sicherzustellen, dass dein Profil mit den Anforderungen des Jobs matcht.

02 Videocall mit HR

In einem ersten Kennelernen sprechen wir über deine Erfahrungen, deine Motivation und die Rolle bei Odoo.

03 Technisches Interview

Jetzt wird's fachlich! Triff unsere Teamleads zu einem persönlichen Gespräch und tauche tief in die Aufgaben der Rolle ein.

04 Erhalte dein Angebot!

Wenn du alle Stufen gemeistert hast, wird es Zeit für das große Finale - ein Angebot, unserem Odoo Berlin Team beizutreten.

title: Research Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Glasford International Deutschland GmbH
description_html:
Wer wir sind

Glasford International Deutschland (GID) ist eine national und international erfolgreich

agierende Personalberatung mit 35-jähriger Erfahrung in der Personalsuche und -

auswahl. Mit 25 Partnerbüros weltweit unterstützen wir Unternehmen bei der Suche

und Auswahl von geeigneten Führungskräften vornehmlich in den Fokusbranchen

Industrial Manufacturing, Technology und Consumer Goods. Langeweile ist bei uns

ein Fremdwort, Eigeninitiative und die Übernahme von Verantwortung werden

ausdrücklich gefördert; Spaß an der Arbeit betrachten wir als Grundlage für gute

Leistungen.

Aufgaben

Teilzeit oder Werkstudent | 20/25 Stunden pro Woche | München

Für die Unterstützung unseres Teams an unserem Hauptsitz im Herzen von München suchen wir ab sofort einen Research Consultant (m/w/d) in Teilzeit oder als Werkstudent.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du unsere Berater bei der Bearbeitung laufender Suchmandate und erhältst einen umfassenden Einblick in die Arbeit einer Personalberatung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Research, der Identifikation geeigneter Kandidaten sowie deren individueller Ansprache und Kommunikation.

Nach einer gründlichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du eigenständig definierte Aufgaben innerhalb unserer Mandate und arbeitest eng mit unseren Beratern und dem Management zusammen. Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in unterschiedliche Unternehmen, Märkte und Positionen und entwickelst zunehmend ein Gespür für passende Kandidatenprofile.

Deine Aufgaben

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Recherche und Identifikation potenziell geeigneter Kandidaten für unsere Suchmandate
  • Analyse relevanter Unternehmen, Märkte und Kandidatenprofile
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Zielfirmenlisten, Longlists und Kandidatenübersichten
  • Aktive und individuelle Ansprache potenzieller Kandidaten über verschiedene Recruitingkanäle
  • Kommunikation mit Kandidaten während des laufenden Prozesses sowie Koordination weiterer Schritte
  • Strukturierte Aufbereitung von Research Ergebnissen und Kandidateninformationen für unsere Berater
  • Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung und Organisation laufender Suchprojekte
  • Koordination und Vereinbarung von Gesprächsterminen zwischen Kandidaten und Beratern
  • Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kandidaten und Projektinformationen in unserem CRM Tool
  • Dokumentation des Projektfortschritts und regelmäßige Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Beratern
  • Teilnahme an Projektbriefings und regelmäßigen Teammeetings

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt zunächst auf Research, Kandidatenidentifikation und Kandidatenkommunikation. Mit zunehmender Erfahrung kannst du schrittweise weitere Aufgaben innerhalb des Recruitingprozesses übernehmen und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Uns ist weniger wichtig, an welchem Punkt deines beruflichen Weges du gerade stehst. Entscheidend ist, dass du Lust hast, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und unser Team zuverlässig zu unterstützen.

Idealerweise:

  • studierst du aktuell oder suchst eine Teilzeitposition mit einem Umfang von etwa 20 bis 25 Stunden pro Woche
  • interessierst du dich für Recruiting, Personalberatung, Unternehmen und unterschiedliche Märkte
  • arbeitest du gerne strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig
  • hast du Freude an Recherche und daran, Informationen systematisch aufzubereiten
  • verfügst du über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und kannst dich gut in neue Themen einarbeiten
  • bringst du Eigeninitiative mit und organisierst deine Aufgaben selbstständig
  • gehst du sicher mit MS Office um
  • verfügst du über gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst englischsprachige Profile und Informationen sicher verstehen

Studiengänge wie Wirtschaftspsychologie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Psychologie, Personalmanagement oder vergleichbare Fachrichtungen können dir den Einstieg erleichtern, sind für uns aber keine Voraussetzung.

Vorkenntnisse im Recruiting oder Research sind ebenfalls nicht erforderlich. Wichtiger sind für uns Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Arbeit.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine Position mit etwa 20 bis 25 Stunden pro Woche, die sich gut mit einem Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen kombinieren lässt
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Feste Homeoffice Möglichkeiten sowie zusätzliche Flexibilität nach Absprache
  • Eine gründliche Einarbeitung und einen direkten Einblick in die Arbeit einer etablierten Personalberatung
  • Abwechslungsreiche Suchprojekte und Einblicke in unterschiedliche Unternehmen, Märkte und Positionen
  • Die Möglichkeit, schnell eigene Aufgabenbereiche zu übernehmen
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Research und perspektivisch auch in weitere Bereiche des Recruitingprozesses
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine offene Duz Kultur
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein hilfsbereites, engagiertes Team
  • Moderne und repräsentative Büroräume in zentraler Lage im Münchner Lehel
  • Und für die Mittagspause liegt der Eisbach praktisch direkt vor der Tür

Interesse?

Wenn du gerne recherchierst, strukturiert arbeitest und Lust hast, die Personalberatung von Grund auf kennenzulernen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns einfach deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und erzähl uns kurz, warum die Position für dich interessant ist.

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role: 

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

  • Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
  • Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
  • Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
  • Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
  • Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
  • Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

  • Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
  • Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
  • Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

  • Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
  • Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
  • Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
  • Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

  • Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
  • Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:

Essential

  • 10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
  • A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
  • Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
  • A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
  • Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
  • Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
  • Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

  • Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
  • Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
  • Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
  • Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
  • Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
  • Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: AI Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Clariness
description_html:
Clariness is looking for an AI Engineer (f/m/d/) based in Germany.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about turning AI and machine learning ideas into reliable, scalable solutions for Clariness' platforms. You will join a collaborative technical environment and work across the AI/ML lifecycle, from understanding a business problem and developing a solution to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement within the regulated clinical-trial space.

As an AI Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and operating production AI and machine learning solutions, including data pipelines, models and inference services.
  • Developing LLM-powered features using approaches such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent workflows, tool calling and structured outputs, with a focus on reliability, measurable quality and cost efficiency.
  • Delivering end-to-end machine learning workflows on Databricks, from data preparation and feature development through training and evaluation to batch and real-time deployment.
  • Maintaining quality in production through versioning, evaluation, monitoring and drift detection, and supporting the investigation and recovery of solutions when issues arise.
  • Collaborating with Product, Engineering, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business needs into scoped technical requirements, measurable success criteria and realistic delivery plans, including relevant data and privacy constraints.
  • Contributing to governance-ready data and AI practices covering quality, lineage, access, security, GDPR and responsible AI, including relevant EU AI Act requirements.
  • Working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to explain trade-offs and model limitations, gather feedback and help prioritize improvements based on their potential impact.
  • Reviewing peer contributions, documenting and sharing knowledge, developing reusable components and helping improve our shared libraries and Data & AI platform tooling.

We would like you to have: 

  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, together with strong English communication skills at C1 level.
  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied AI, Data Science or a related field, including experience taking at least one AI or machine learning solution from prototype into production.
  • Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent technologies, along with solid SQL and warehouse or lakehouse experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including several of the following: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow or Workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and deploying models beyond the experimentation stage, with an understanding of monitoring, reliability and production quality.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as RAG, prompt workflows and evaluation, as well as cloud platforms, ideally AWS, and CI/CD practices for machine learning, or the foundations and motivation to develop further in these areas.
  • The ability to independently deliver well-defined AI/ML tasks, collaborate with product and business stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs, model behavior and limitations to non-technical audiences.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Take Home Test → Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

Clariness GmbH will treat the above information strictly confidential and will especially observe the applicable provisions of the applicable data protection laws. Further information about the use of the applicant data, you will find in the data protection declaration online at https://www.clariness.com/privacy-policy/

title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Swarmaero
description_html:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

READ THIS PART FIRST

Legion is not a normal web application. It is command and control software that has to present dense real-time information, coordinate distributed systems, and continue being useful when communications are imperfect.

WHAT WE DO

Swarm Aero is redefining air power. We are building autonomous aircraft and Legion, command and control software designed to coordinate large numbers of heterogeneous autonomous systems. Our team combines experience building novel aircraft, scaling startups, and delivering technology for national security.

THE INTERNSHIP

You will own a scoped project with a clear technical or business outcome, work directly with the people responsible for the system, and present what you built and learned at the end of the summer. The goal is not to give you practice work. It is to give you useful work with the support to do it well.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

· Build product features across frontend, backend, full-stack, real-time, or forward-deployed software

· Develop interfaces for telemetry, geospatial data, mission planning, scheduling, collaboration, or system health

· Build and operate backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, or data pipelines

· Write automated tests, improve developer tooling, and help ship production-quality software

· Support integration and test events, debug issues across services and networks, and turn what you learn into product improvements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

· Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, with graduation and enrollment requirements to be confirmed.

· Strong programming fundamentals and experience building a substantial software project

· Experience with a modern frontend framework, backend language, systems language, or full-stack application

· Ability to explain technical tradeoffs, debug methodically, and write maintainable code

WHAT SETS YOU APART

· React, TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C++, or similar tools

· Distributed systems, networking, real-time applications, maps, games, simulation, or data visualization

· Linux, Docker, CI/CD, customer-facing engineering, or deployed project experience

WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

Aerospace experience, a perfect GPA, or a previous internship at a famous company. Show us what you have built, analyzed, tested, organized, or improved, and be ready to explain your contribution clearly.

THE HONEST VERSION

The pace is fast, the problems will not arrive fully defined, and you may spend part of the summer learning why your first approach was wrong. We will expect you to ask questions, test your assumptions, document your work, and leave the project better than you found it.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $35 per hour

  • • $35 per hour

title: Technical Sourcer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Swarmaero
description_html:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Read this part first

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.

We are not going to make you wait.

What we do

We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.

That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job

You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.

Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there

  • Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome

  • Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form

  • The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first

  • Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you

  • A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have

What we need from you

  • 1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering

  • A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them

  • A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway

  • Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in

  • Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete

  • Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right

What we do not need

Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.

The honest version

The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.

If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

title: Staff Software Engineer, Real-Time Systems
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Swarmaero
description_html:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Most backend roles ask you to wire up an API and move records in and out of a database. This one asks you to build the systems that keep the largest drone swarm on the planet coordinated in real time.

You'll help architect the backend for Legion's Command & Control platform: the systems that let a single operator plan, direct, and execute missions across a networked swarm of heterogeneous aircraft, in real time, over intermittent comms, at a scale nobody else in the industry is attempting. This isn't CRUD. It's real-time distributed systems, high-throughput telemetry pipelines, and infrastructure for a problem space that barely has prior art.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Help architect the backend for a C2 system directing swarms of heterogeneous aircraft

  • Build distributed, collaborative real-time infrastructure for controlling large numbers of aircraft simultaneously, even when comms drop

  • Design and build the services that ingest, process, and distribute dense vehicle telemetry, sensor data, scheduling, crew resources, and data link management, much of it with no existing playbook to follow

  • Own backend features end to end, from design through deployment

  • Ship early, ship often, backed by strong CI/CD, QA, and DevSecOps

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

  • 6+ years building complex backend systems with real distributed systems depth

About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar
