description_html:
Up to €86k OTE | Uncapped Commission | Territory Ownership

The Opportunity Do you want the freedom to work completely independently, but with the backing of a global tech leader?

We are looking for a Field Account Executive to conquer the Berlin hospitality market. In this role, you aren’t just an employee; you are the owner of your specific territory. You will have full freedom to plan your day, build your own network, and manage your sales pipe.

We don't care about micromanagement; we care about results. You will be measured on your success, with a transparent promotion path based purely on revenue milestones.

 

***Note that this role is based in Berlin, Germany***

Your Journey with Us

  • Month 1 (Onboarding): We invest in you. You will undergo a comprehensive 1-month onboarding program to master the product, the market, and our sales methodology.

  • Month 2 & Beyond: You get your territory in Berlin. It’s yours to map, hunt, and harvest.

What You Will Do

  • Active Field Presence: You will be present in the Berlin market daily. Your primary approach is face-to-face interaction—visiting restaurants, cafes, and bars to introduce them to Lightspeed personally.

  • Full Cycle Ownership: You control the process from the very first handshake to the signed contract. You are responsible for self-sourcing, prospecting, demoing, and closing.

  • Consultative Selling: You aren't just selling software; you are helping restaurateurs build better businesses. You will listen to their needs and build custom solutions.

  • Build Your Network: You will become a known face in your local hospitality scene, building long-term relationships and a referral network.

Who You Are

  • A Hunter: You love the thrill of the chase. You are self-motivated and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to get work done.

  • German Native/Fluent: You have excellent communication skills in German (essential for building trust with local owners) and are comfortable in English.

  • Resilient & Charismatic: You have strong presentation skills and the confidence to walk into a busy restaurant and strike up a conversation.

  • Ambitious: You want to write your own paycheck through uncapped commissions.

  • Experience: 1+ years in sales, business development, or hospitality operations is a plus—but your attitude and drive matter most.

What’s in it for You?

  • Strong Earning Potential: Target earnings of up to €86,000 OTE (Base + Commission).

  • Uncapped Commission: The OTE is just a target—our commission plan is uncapped. The more you sell, the more you earn.

  • Team Power: You are never alone. You will join a local squad of 8-10 sales pros based in our Berlin HQ, part of a wider network across major cities. We conquer the region together.

  • Growth: A clear career path where achieving revenue milestones leads directly to promotion.

  • Equity: Join our equity scheme and become an owner of Lightspeed.

  • Culture: Work with a lean, high-impact team that celebrates wins. Join us for social events, including our legendary global Sales Summit in Canada.

  • Health & Wellness:

    • €400/year Wellness Credit (Gym, Yoga, Equipment).

    • Mental Health Support via the Modern Health App.

    • Subsidy for your Berlin public transport travel pass.

  • Office Perks: When you aren't in the field, enjoy breakfast, lunches, and drinks in our Berlin office.

Ready to own your territory? Apply now.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at væridion
description_html:
Your Mission:

As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams.

  • Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results.

  • Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware.

  • Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases.

  • Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs.

  • Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data.

  • Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial.

  • 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments.

  • Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable.

  • Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis.

  • Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior.

  • Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature.

  • Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable.

  • Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with tools such as Ansys (Mechanical/LS-DYNA), MSC/NX Nastran, Altair (HyperMesh/OptiStruct/Radioss), or COMSOL is beneficial.

  • Experience implementing user-defined material models and subroutines in Abaqus (UMAT/VUMAT/UMATHT), including the ability to write and debug Fortran, is desirable.

  • Proficiency in scripting: Python for Abaqus automation and post-processing, and Python or MATLAB for closed-form and lower-order analysis methods used to size hardware and verify finite element results.

  • Proficiency with 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks or CATIA, is desirable; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial.

  • Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables.

  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable.

  • Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial.

  • Experience with battery systems or electric propulsion systems is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

  • Fluent English language skills are essential; German language skills are beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is developing sustainable electric aviation solutions that will redefine regional air mobility. Our Technology division combines aerospace engineering, software development, systems engineering, and certification expertise to deliver highly reliable and certifiable aviation products.

As Senior DevOps & Engineering Platform Engineer (all genders), you will play a key role in shaping VÆRIDION's engineering ecosystem. Working at the intersection of software engineering, systems engineering, IT, and aerospace certification, you will design, build, and operate the engineering platforms and cloud infrastructure that enable the development of next-generation electric aircraft.

The position is responsible for establishing and continuously evolving the infrastructure that supports software development, model-based design, simulation, testing, traceability, verification, validation, and certification activities across the organization. Through the implementation of modern DevOps practices and automation strategies, the role enables engineering teams to develop, test, and certify products efficiently while meeting the stringent requirements of the aerospace industry.

Success in this position requires a strong combination of cloud architecture expertise, DevOps and platform engineering experience, software development knowledge, understanding of regulated aerospace development processes, and excellent stakeholder management skills.

Within the first 12 months, the role is expected to establish a scalable engineering platform used for VÆRIDION’s airborne battery system, automate significant portions of software development and certification workflows, integrate MathWorks and Model-Based Design toolchains into the CI/CD environment, enable automated SIL, PIL, and HIL verification pipelines, establish end-to-end traceability from requirements to verification evidence, and create a robust foundation for future aircraft software certification activities.

Your Mission:

As Team Lead Airborne Electronics (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and lead the development of airborne electronic hardware supporting the propulsion battery system. You will be responsible for guiding the design, development, integration, and verification of electronic systems for battery management, high-voltage monitoring, and power electronics supporting VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team developing airborne electronics for battery management systems, high-voltage sensing and protection, and power electronics such as solid-state power controllers and inverter interfaces. This role combines technical leadership, system integration oversight, and program coordination, ensuring that electronic systems supporting the propulsion battery system meet the highest standards of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Your work will directly contribute to the development of the high-voltage electrical power system at the core of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the design and development of airborne electronic hardware supporting propulsion battery monitoring, control, protection, and high-voltage power distribution.

  • Manage and mentor a team of electronics engineers responsible for battery management electronics, sensing systems, and power electronics hardware.

  • Define system architectures and hardware concepts for battery management electronics, high-voltage monitoring and protection systems, solid-state power controllers (SSPCs), and inverter interface electronics.

  • Oversee schematic capture, PCB development, and component selection for both low-voltage control electronics and high-voltage power electronics systems.

  • Establish and implement airborne electronics development processes aligned with aviation standards and certification requirements.

  • Coordinate cross-disciplinary integration with systems engineering, propulsion, battery, software, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless system integration.

  • Guide the development and validation of power electronics hardware, including protection circuits, switching devices, gate drivers, sensing systems, and control electronics.

  • Oversee hardware prototyping, board bring-up, and bench-level debugging, ensuring rapid iteration from concept prototypes through to flight-representative hardware.

  • Plan and oversee hardware verification activities including functional testing, environmental testing, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) validation.

  • Lead technical design reviews and ensure electronic systems meet reliability, safety, and certification requirements.

  • Collaborate closely with safety and systems engineering on the functional safety of the electronics hardware, providing design inputs to the hazard and safety assessments (FHA, PSSA, SSA) and ensuring the hardware meets its allocated Design Assurance Levels (DAL) in line with ARP4754A/ARP4761 and DO-254 objectives.

  • Own reliability engineering activities for the electronics hardware, including FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction (MTBF), component derating, and worst-case circuit analysis.

  • Ensure design-for-manufacture (DFM) and design-for-test (DFT) principles are applied, and lead the transfer of electronics designs into serial production with manufacturing and supply-chain partners.

  • Contribute to certification planning by supporting compliance documentation, design assurance activities, and system traceability.

  • Drive continuous improvement of electronics development workflows, toolchains, and testing methodologies.

  • Proven experience leading or coordinating engineering teams developing airborne electronic hardware.

  • Strong experience in analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, and PCB development.

  • Experience with power electronics hardware, including switching devices, gate drivers, protection circuits, or high-voltage control electronics.

  • Experience with battery management systems, high-voltage monitoring electronics, electric propulsion systems, SSPCs, or inverter electronics is highly desirable.

title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at væridion
description_html:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level

  • Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs

  • Design, implement, and validate estimation algorithms such as Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and data-driven/ML methods, while respecting the certification limitations of ML-based approaches

  • Develop mission-aware predictors that ingest flight-profile and navigation data to predict SoF until safe landing, and compute the energy margin, the predicted surplus SoF at destination, and the SoF trend presented to the crew, updating on diversion, altitude, speed, and ambient changes

  • Develop aging and degradation models and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and validate the SoH algorithm against the applicable end-of-life criteria across representative mission and durability profiles

  • Ensure the algorithms align with ED-289 requirements for state observers and predictors and ED-309 methodologies for energy level information to the crew, and are consistent with the “Manage Energy” functional breakdown

  • Ensure the algorithms meet functional-safety expectations for a DAL B function: deterministic and bounded execution time, reproducibility, uncertainty bounds on outputs, plausibility checks, built-in test, and malfunction and fault detection

  • Derive, document, and trace algorithm requirements from ED-289/ED-309 and system-level functional analysis, and maintain traceability into the real-time battery management software specification using a model-based design approach

  • Support the real-time embedded realization of estimators and predictors on the pack, lane, and central control units (fixed-point implementation, Simulink code generation, MISRA C) and validate them on HiL setups

  • Define the test and analysis strategy for virtual and physical battery test benches and HiL rigs, and analyze cell, cell-bank, and pack-level data to evaluate algorithm accuracy, stability, and robustness across temperature, aging, and usage variability

  • Set the standard for documentation of methods, assumptions, and validation results

  • Lead collaboration with cell engineering, BMS software, test, HV/LV electrical systems, and certification teams

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Control Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in battery state estimation, control systems, or embedded algorithm development

  • Strong command of state estimation and control theory: Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and system modeling, with an awareness of data-driven and ML methods and their certification constraints

  • Solid battery domain knowledge: lithium-ion electrochemistry, equivalent-circuit and thermal models, aging and degradation mechanisms (capacity fade, resistance growth, lithium plating), OCV hysteresis, and cell-bank-level state granularity

  • Proficiency in Matlab/Simulink and Python, with familiarity with C/C++, fixed-point implementation, Git, and CI/CD

  • Experience with real-time simulation, HiL testing, and embedded systems

  • Familiarity with aerospace functional safety and certification: DO-178C/ED-12C and the DAL concept, requirements-based verification and validation, MBSE and model-based design, and relevant battery and energy standards (ED-289, ED-309, DO-311A, SAE AIR6897); DO-160 environmental awareness is a plus

  • Analytical mindset, strong attention to detail, the ability to own deliverables end-to-end, and clear technical documentation skills

description_html:
Your Mission:

We are seeking a (Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (all genders) to lead the design and development of the flight control systems for our battery-electric aircraft. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and integrating the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control systems, including both mechanical and electrically actuated elements, working in close collaboration with the flight physics, structures, and systems teams. You will drive the flight control system throughout its complete development lifecycle, from system-level requirements definition through architecture development, preliminary and detailed design, supplier coordination, integration, verification and validation activities, and ultimately system and aircraft certification. Working cross-functionally with structures, avionics, flight physics, systems, and overall aircraft design, you will ensure robust integration of the flight control system within the aircraft. As a senior engineer, you will play a central role in technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and the maturation of the overall aircraft configuration.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define, derive, and manage system-level requirements for the flight control system, ensuring alignment with aircraft-level requirements, program objectives, and applicable certification regulations (CS-23 and related operational requirements).

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition, architecture definition, interface identification, and traceability management.

  • Lead the detailed definition, development, and integration of the flight control system, covering installation design, kinematics, load paths, performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety considerations.

  • Own the technical coordination and oversight of suppliers and development partners, including requirement allocation, design reviews, verification activities, and compliance demonstration.

  • Support and contribute to system safety activities related to flight controls, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA/SFHA), Preliminary System Safety Assessments (PSSA), and Zonal Safety Analysis,in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Actively contribute to the design implementation and configuration control of the flight control system within the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU), ensuring proper integration with structures and other aircraft systems.

  • Support the flight controls certification process, including preparation and review of certification plans, compliance checklists, qualification documentation and execution, and participation in ground and flight test campaigns.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering(or equivalent).

  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in the development of mechanically actuated aircraft flight control systems, preferably within Part 23aircraftprogramsoperatingunder a DOA environment or international equivalent.

  • Strong background in systems engineering applied to flight controls, including requirement capture and management, functional decomposition, interface definition, and traceability.

  • Demonstrated expertise in the design, integration, assembly, and testing of mechanical primary flight control systems, including kinematics, load transmission, tolerance management, friction and free-play control, and troubleshooting during ground and flight test campaigns.

  • Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual architecture and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (Part 23 or Part 25).

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification processes, including compliance demonstration and interaction with airworthiness authorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset.

  • Proficiency in PLM and CAD systems; Dassault’s 3DX platform is a plus.

  • Strong personal motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

description_html:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world's first electric nine-seater aircraft. As a PCB Layout Engineer (all genders) in our Technology division, you will own the physical design of the printed circuit boards at the heart of our high-voltage propulsion battery and power-distribution systems, turning engineering intent into flight-ready, manufacturable and certifiable hardware. Partnering closely with our electronics, hardware and manufacturing engineers from schematic to fabrication, you will apply IPC standards and aerospace-grade design discipline to hardware that must be safe, reliable and light enough to fly - work that directly underpins the propulsion battery system at the core of our mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Design, route and iterate multilayer PCB layouts from schematics, netlists and engineering requirements.

  • Define and document PCB stack-ups, controlled-impedance geometries and reference-plane strategies together with the hardware engineers.

  • Perform ECAD–MCAD co-design with the mechanical team, including STEP exchange, board-outline and keep-out definition, and connector and component placement against enclosure and thermal constraints.

  • Apply high-voltage layout discipline - creepage and clearance, isolation barriers and 3W spacing - in line with IPC-2221 and the demands of aerospace high-voltage battery systems.

  • Engineer for signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, manufacturability and thermal management, using thermal vias, heavy-copper and metal-clad constructions.

  • Create and govern the PCB component library — schematic symbols, footprints and 3D models - in accordance with IPC standards.

  • Ensure designs comply with IPC-2221, IPC-7351 and IPC-6012 (including Class 3 expectations for high-reliability hardware) and other relevant IPC standards.

  • Produce complete fabrication and assembly data packages: Gerbers, ODB++/IPC-2581, drill files, BOMs, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.

  • Perform design rule checks (DRC), electrical rule checks and layout-versus-schematic verification, and support design and readiness reviews.

  • Collaborate with electronics and hardware engineers to implement design changes and resolve layout issues.

  • Partner with PCB fabricators and assemblers to resolve DFM/DFA feedback and manufacturing topics, and to qualify new suppliers and processes.

  • Maintain rigorous revision control, configuration management and technical documentation across the hardware baseline.

 

Your Profile:

  • Diploma, associate degree or vocational qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology or a related field.

  • Minimum of five years of hands-on experience in PCB layout or electronics design support.

  • Proven proficiency with a professional ECAD tool such as Altium Designer (preferred), OrCAD/Allegro, Zuken, Eagle, KiCad or similar.

  • Strong working knowledge of IPC PCB design, fabrication and assembly standards, and the ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.

  • Solid understanding of multilayer stack-up design, controlled impedance and PCB manufacturing technologies (rigid, flex, rigid-flex, hybrid, thick-copper, metal-clad).

  • Effective communication and teamwork skills in an English-speaking, cross-functional engineering environment.

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

Hiya is building the future of trusted voice.

title: Senior Software Engineer Platform

description_html:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will work on the core cloud platform that enables all other engineering teams at Qdrant. You’ll design and evolve shared services, control-plane components, and internal APIs that power our managed cloud offering and support enterprise-grade deployments.

This role is about building platform primitives and abstractions, not day-to-day operations. You’ll focus on reducing complexity, improving developer productivity, and driving architectural evolution across the cloud platform.

What you will own

  • Design and evolve core platform services and internal APIs consumed by multiple teams.

  • Drive architectural initiatives such as gRPC migration, eventing/pub-sub foundations, and platform refactors.

  • Own and improve control-plane and cluster-api components.

  • Build platform abstractions that reduce operational and cognitive load for other teams.

  • Write production-grade Go code for platform services and internal tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with Regions & Clusters, Resilience, and Features teams to enable delivery through platform primitives.

  • Improve platform scalability, reliability, and developer experience through thoughtful design.

  • Support production systems and incident response when needed, with a focus on long-term fixes.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python, or deep expertise in one with willingness to work regularly with both.

  • Solid experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and API design.

  • Experience building and operating production systems used by other engineers or teams.

  • Comfortable working cross-team and driving technical alignment.

  • Ownership mindset and clear communication skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with gRPC, event-driven architectures, or control-plane systems.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes operators or cluster-level abstractions.

  • Background in SaaS, database, or systems-level product companies.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!


For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead

description_html:
About Comena

Comena builds AI agents for industrial distributors and manufacturers to automate their order processing from e-mail inbox to ERP. At distributors across the US and Germany alone, there are 4 million sales and procurement people stuck in manual workflows between inbox and ERP. We want to automate this work and liberate these people to work on more meaningful things.

We’re part of the YC S25 batch - the most selective batch in YC history. We recently raised a seed round from top Silicon Valley investors, and are serving customers across US and Germany.

 

About the role

Comena is delivering seven-figure deployments for leading industrial companies across the US, UK and the EU.

As our Forward Deployed Engineering Lead, you will own the bridge between our product, engineering team, and customers, defining how Comena is implemented and scaled across organizations.

You will be responsible for ensuring customers successfully adopt Comena, creating scalable processes for implementation, and helping our engineering team move faster by turning customer learnings into clear technical requirements.

This is a high-ownership role combining customer success, engineering, and operational excellence. You will work closely with customers to understand their workflows, coordinate deployments with engineers, identify recurring implementation challenges, and build the systems that allow us to onboard customers faster as we scale.

Key responsibilities

Customer onboarding and deployment ownership: Lead the full customer implementation lifecycle, from initial discovery through successful production rollout. Own customer onboarding processes, coordinate deployments, and ensure customers successfully adopt Comena’s AI platform. Work closely with customers to understand their workflows, data, and systems, and collaborate with engineers to deliver reliable solutions.

Deployment strategy and process building: Establish the processes, playbooks, and best practices that enable faster and more consistent customer deployments. Identify bottlenecks in onboarding and work with engineering and product teams to improve tooling, documentation, and workflows that make future FDE deployments more efficient.

Cross-functional collaboration: Act as the bridge between customers, founders, and engineers. Translate customer needs and operational challenges into clear technical requirements, coordinate engineering efforts, and ensure alignment between customer expectations and product capabilities.

We’re looking for someone that …

  • Has high agency, can operate independently, and takes ownership of customer outcomes.

  • Has excellent communication skills (fluent English and German is a must) and enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Is comfortable managing complex software deployments and collaborating closely with engineers.

  • Can translate customer workflows and business requirements into actionable technical solutions.

  • Enjoys building processes from scratch and creating scalable systems for a growing company.

  • Has strong problem-solving skills and thrives in ambiguous startup environments.

  • Loves startups and running together to make something great happen.

  • Wants to work very hard beyond traditional 9-5 hours.

Tech Stack

We work with Python (Django), Typescript, Postgres, and the latest LLMs.

 

Why join us?

  • Your work will directly impact workers and companies around the world, to make global supply chains run smoothly.

  • We’re keeping our team deliberately small. We believe more people translate to more output if and only if each member is elite.

  • You’ll be working with cracked founders. Jiehua was the youngest software engineer at Google Zurich and the first sales hire at Lio (YC S23). Almo shipped code at Microsoft and Amazon AWS, and was the first engineer at Leaping AI (YC W25).

  • If you need any perks to feel productive, let us know and we’ll make it happen.

 

About the interview

  1. 15 min intro call with Youssef

  2. 60 min technical interview with Almo

  3. Take-home assignment / case study

  4. In-person co-working day

  5. Offer

Technical Architect (all genders)

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time · Available immediately

About the Role

You will own the technical architecture of our largest enterprise engagements, from CRM object and data models to integrations and production AI agents. That means you decide how a solution is built, you write the design others build from, and you defend it in front of client architects and IT leadership. If you have been the person who quietly fixed architecture decisions someone else made too late, this is the seat where you make them first.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of our largest enterprise engagements, from object and data model through to integration design.

  • Introduce an architecture review gate so that no significant build starts without a documented, reviewed design.

  • Cut unplanned rework by finding the integration and data-model problems in design instead of in build.

  • Design production-grade agentic solutions on Claude API, MCP, and HubSpot as the data layer, including data access, evaluation, and cost control.

  • Build a reusable library of integration and data-model patterns that shortens every following project.

  • Lead technically in presales: you shape the solution and the estimate behind our enterprise proposals.

  • Raise the technical level around you through architecture reviews, deep-dives, and documentation engineers actually use.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 5 or more years designing architectures for enterprise CRM or comparable business platforms, including at least one multi-brand or multi-business-unit landscape

  • Hands-on integration design between CRM and surrounding systems (ERP, PIM, shop, data platforms) with a clear view on when to use which pattern

  • Experience taking an LLM-based or agentic solution into production, not just prototypes, including data access, evaluation, and cost

  • Architecture documents and decision records you have authored yourself, which engineers built from and clients signed off

  • Ability to hold a technical position with client-side architects and IT leadership, in German and English

  • Solid estimation judgement: you can translate a design into PT and know which choices protect margin

Nice-to-haves

  • HubSpot platform depth (custom objects, data governance, permission models, CMS)

  • Background in custom development or engineering before moving into architecture

  • Consulting or agency experience with multiple parallel clients

Your Team

You will report to the Practice Lead Development & Technology and join the Tech Consulting Team inside Thorit's Development & Technology Practice, alongside the Development, AI, and UX & UI teams. Since the Team Lead Tech Consulting seat is currently unfilled, you work directly with the Practice Lead, with a high degree of autonomy over how architecture is done here. You will work across our Böblingen headquarters and our Lisbon engineering hub.

Tech Stack

HubSpot (CRM, custom objects, CMS), Claude API and MCP, Jira, Confluence, Forecast.it, plus the client-side systems you will integrate against (ERP, PIM, shop platforms, data warehouses) and modern AI-assisted development tooling.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our Böblingen headquarters, with flexible hours and trust instead of tracking

  • 30 days annual leave

  • A company pension scheme (bAV) with employer contribution

  • JobRad leasing and a mobility allowance

  • A certification and training budget you choose how to spend, including AI tooling for daily work

  • Regular exchange with our Lisbon hub, including on-site time there

  • Architecture authority from day one: this is a design role, not a review-committee seat

  • Modern hardware of your choice

About Thorit

Thorit is one of Europe's leading HubSpot partners and a top business and technology consultancy. We combine strategic advisory with hands-on IT implementation, from CRM architecture to fully automated go-to-market infrastructure powered by AI and agentic systems.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but a concrete example of an architecture you designed and took into production, including what you got wrong, is required.

title: US Market & Sales Development Rep - Munich (Native English Required) (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliro
description_html:
Location: Munich
Start: Immediately
Duration: 3-6 months
Type: Full-time internship / Part-Time Working Student

Please note: This role requires native-level American English

Bliro is exploring the US market, and we're looking for someone to lead our very first outbound efforts there - from Munich. Whether you're an exchange student, intern, or just here for a semester abroad - this is a high-ownership, high-visibility role: you'll be talking directly to American prospects every day, and the pipeline you build will shape one of the biggest decisions Bliro makes this year.

About Bliro

At Bliro, we're revolutionizing the daily work of sales teams with AI. 2.5 million field sales reps in Germany alone lose hours every day to manual follow-up work. Bliro solves exactly that problem - with proprietary AI technology developed at TU Munich and funded by the Federal Ministry of Economics and the EU Commission, which transcribes and analyzes customer conversations in real time, whether online or in person. This allows teams worldwide to make data-driven decisions and automate their processes.

Today, more than 2,000 companies already trust Bliro - including fast-growing startups, established corporates, and mid-sized companies (e.g. igus, Lanxess, and Telefónica Deutschland). Backed by top investors, we're now looking for a motivated Sales (SDR) intern to help drive our growth even further.

Our sales team brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world (ex-Deel, ex-Autodesk, ex-Celonis) as well as their own startup founding experience!

👇 See for yourself what you'll be selling to sales teams:

Sounds like the future? It is. And you can help shape it!

🎯 Your Responsibilities

  1. Own outbound prospecting into the US market - research, cold-call, and open conversations with potential customers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.

  2. Qualify leads rigorously, distinguishing genuine buying interest from polite enthusiasm - you'll need good instincts for reading US business conversations specifically.

  3. Book and manage a pipeline of introductory calls and demos.

  4. Work closely with founders and the Account Executive team to shape how we position Bliro for American prospects.

  5. Bring structure to a brand-new motion - there's no existing playbook here, so your feedback on what works will directly influence our approach.

  6. Support a leadership visit to the US to meet prospects in person, helping prepare briefings and scheduling.

🧠 Your Profile

We're not looking for finished professionals - we're looking for doers with passion and curiosity.

What you should bring:

  • Native or near-native American English speaker, with genuine fluency in US business communication norms and small talk.

  • Confident and natural on the phone - you can build rapport with a stranger quickly.

  • Currently a student (any field) or in a gap year, based in or able to work from Munich for the duration of the role.

  • Resilient and self-motivated - comfortable with high call volume and undeterred by rejection.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Prior experience in outbound sales (e.g. internships, working student jobs, part-time jobs)

  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or other outreach tools

  • Working German sufficient to collaborate day-to-day with the Munich team (native German not required).

💡 Why Bliro

💸 Compensation + perks worth mentioning
This isn't an "internship for experience" - you'll get a fair salary, an uncapped variable bonus (yes, even as an intern), a Deutschlandticket, Wellpass, and food and drinks in the office. Your effort gets rewarded. Learning budget? We've got it. Sales library? Of course. Personal coaching? Included too

🌍 20 people, 9 countries, one network
Here you'll meet creativity and internationality. You'll work with people who think along with you, laugh with you, and want to grow with you. Our team also brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world. On top of that, you'll benefit from our strong network in Munich's startup ecosystem - with connections to VCs and founders.

📍 An office location that's hard to beat

Our office sits right above the Augustiner Stammhaus - right in the heart of Munich. Whether it's lunch with a view of the city or a quick after-work beer around the corner: you won't find a better neighborhood.

🥳 Real team spirit, every month

We don't wait for the annual offsite. At Bliro, there are monthly team events - from mini golf and bowling to burrito nights and pickleball. Spontaneous lunches and coffee breaks included.

🧑‍💻 Flexible
9 to 5 not your thing? No problem. Whether from your kitchen table or the office - what matters to us is the result, not the location. And yes, pajama pants are officially allowed when working from home.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You'll never pitch alone
Your start at Bliro will be accompanied by a buddy who onboards you, catches you when needed, and keeps you supplied with memes. We're team players - from day one to your first successful demo (and beyond).

Do you want to experience and help shape the sales side of an AI startup from the ground up? Then apply now!

Let's build the future of Sales - together. 💥

title: Sr Marketing Manager - DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Legora
description_html:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

You are joining an early-stage scale-up with exceptional product-market fit, trusted by leading DACH firms like Boehringer Ingelheim, Roland Berger, and SGS SA. Backed by over $600M in funding from top investors including Accel, ICONIQ, General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, Benchmark, Redpoint, and Y Combinator. And a world-class team from Google, Klarna, Spotify, Slack, and top tier consulting and law firms with infinite room to grow professionally.

The Role

We're looking for a marketing manager to join our Munich team and lead the execution of high-impact marketing programs across DACH. This role will play a key part in driving brand awareness, pipeline growth, and customer loyalty through regional field initiatives, including creative brand marketing, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, field marketing, community, and content marketing.

You'll report to the Marketing Director for EMEA and collaborate closely with the global marketing team, including demand generation, product marketing, content, and design. You'll be embedded in the regional go-to-market and engagement teams to plan and execute programs that drive customer acquisition, engage target accounts, and nurture customer relationships. You will play a key role towards achieving new business pipeline, upsell pipeline and renewals targets across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow Legora's brand presence across DACH, ensuring Legora shows up wherever our customers are with consistent positioning and messaging across all regional marketing activities.

  • Develop regional marketing strategy and campaign plans, defining objectives, target audiences, messaging themes, and channel mix to drive awareness, engagement, and pipeline contribution.

  • Lead the conception and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, coordinating across digital, social, content, and in-person channels to deliver cohesive go-to-market initiatives.

  • Design and manage regional field marketing programs, including industry conferences, community events, sponsorships, and Legora-hosted experiences tailored to DACH buyers.

  • Partner with the DACH sales and partner teams to align marketing initiatives with pipeline goals, account strategies, and customer acquisition priorities.

  • Own end-to-end event production, including venue selection, vendor management, attendee communications, GTM enablement, run-of-show planning, content and speaker preparation, onsite execution, and post-event processing.

  • Build, manage and execute a pipeline of customer stories which translate Legora's impact into compelling proof points, driving advocacy and loyalty.

  • Develop content amplification strategies that extend the reach of Legora's thought leadership, product stories, and customer narratives across relevant DACH channels.

  • Execute targeted demand-generation campaigns that support field programs, leveraging email, paid media, social, and out-of-home placements to drive attendance, engagement, and conversions.

  • Source and activate customer advocates, identifying DACH customers for case studies, co-marketing opportunities, testimonials, and speaking engagements.

  • Track performance of all regional marketing activities, analyzing results, reporting ROI, and using insights to refine and optimize future programs.

  • Manage relationships with regional agencies, vendors, and marketing partners, ensuring seamless collaboration, quality execution, and budget adherence.

  • Generate creative concepts that elevate brand experience, enhancing engagement, differentiation, and the overall impact of Legora's presence at every touchpoint.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, prefer ably in SaaS or technology sectors, or in a creative marketing role in an agency environment.

  • Hands-on experience supporting events, sponsorships, or regional campaigns.

  • Strong creative instincts paired with a bias for action and ability to execute with speed and precision.

  • Ability to wear multiple hats as needed in a dynamic, rapidly evolving organisation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable collaborating across functions and regions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with marketing automation and GTM/CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Pardot, Customer.io, Clay) is a plus.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description_html:
For an international HR IT separation and stand-alone program, we are looking for an experienced Senior HR IT Project Lead to support the project on a full-time basis.

The role combines operational project leadership with strong technical HR IT understanding. The consultant will work across several HR IT workstreams, identify dependencies and blockers, actively drive topics forward, and closely support internal workstream owners where HR IT knowledge is currently limited.

This is not a pure PMO or reporting role. We are looking for someone who can understand complex HR system landscapes, challenge technical topics, structure unclear situations and actively push workstreams toward delivery.

  • Start: October 2026
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Location: Predominantly remote (very occasional workshops onsite)
  • Language: English
  • Contract type: Freelance / B2B

Tasks

  • Take operational ownership across several HR IT workstreams within an international carve-out / separation program
  • Coordinate technical and functional activities across SAP HCM and related HR systems
  • Drive interface, integration and data-flow topics between HR applications
  • Identify blockers, risks and dependencies and actively push resolution
  • Closely support and coach internal workstream owners with limited HR IT experience
  • Manage dependencies between Recruiting, Core HR, Payroll, Workforce/Time and other HR systems
  • Track critical work packages and escalate delays where required
  • Work independently with internal stakeholders and external delivery partners

Requirements

  • Senior experience in complex HR IT transformation or separation programs
  • Strong SAP HCM / SAP HR background
  • Very good understanding of HR system integrations, interfaces and data flows
  • Proven project or workstream leadership experience
  • Experience with international HR system landscapes
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to quickly structure complex situations and drive topics independently
  • Excellent English skills

Nice-to-haves:

  • Carve-out, divestiture, TSA exit or stand-alone setup experience
  • SuccessFactors and/or SmartRecruiters experience
  • Payroll and/or Workforce Management / Time & Attendance experience
  • SAP HCM exposure in APAC and/or the Americas

title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Greencells Gmbh
description_html:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

description_html:
Deine Rolle bei Karriere Tutor

Karriere Tutor steht für moderne, praxisnahe Weiterbildung und Umschulung – und für eine Lernkultur, die Menschen stark macht. Du möchtest mit deinem Know-how und deiner Persönlichkeit etwas bewegen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und begleite unsere Teilnehmenden in ihrer persönlichen Entwicklung. 

So sieht dein Tag bei uns aus:

Als Team Lead für Weiterbildungsangebote im Team AI und Data Science AI verantwortest du die Durchführung und inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kurse im Team KI und Data Science. 

Dafür führst du ein Team von Dozierenden, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kursproduktionen und -inhalte für unser Produktmanagement und sorgst mit deinem Team für eine qualitativ hochwertige und didaktisch wertvolle Vermittlung der Inhalte an unsere Teilnehmenden.    

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team von Dozierenden im Bereich Data & AI und gibst fachliche Orientierung für die Weiterentwicklung der Kurse.  
  • Du gibst als Subject Matter Expert wichtigen Input zur Weiterentwicklung des Kursportfolios deines Themenfelds ein, hilfst uns inhaltliche Trends zu erkennen und relevante Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen zu entwickeln.  
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning und Analytics und leitest daraus relevante Themen, Technologien und Qualifizierungsangebote für unser Portfolio ab.  
  • Du stellst die fachliche Qualität unserer Weiterbildungen sicher und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Inhalte, Lernziele, Konzepte und Formate kontinuierlich weiter.  
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden und Fachexpert:innen zusammen und unterstützt sie bei der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Kurse.  
  • Du stellst die adäquate qualitative und quantitative Besetzung deines Teams mit internen und externen Dozierenden sicher und steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Dispositions-Team ihren Einsatz in Lehre und Kursproduktionen. 
  • Du analysierst Markt-, Kunden- und Teilnehmendenfeedback und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um bestehende Angebote zu optimieren und neue Angebote zu entwickeln.  
Kurz: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser AI und Data Science Weiterbildungsportfolio fachlich relevant, technologisch aktuell und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt. 


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Data & AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld.  
  • Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams bzw. Netzwerken.  
  • Fundiertes Verständnis aktueller Entwicklungen im Bereich Data & AI sowie ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Technologien und Kompetenzen für Arbeitsmarkt und Weiterbildung relevant sind.  
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung oder Steuerung von Weiterbildungs-, Trainings- oder Qualifizierungsangeboten.  
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Dozierenden, Fachexpert:innen und unterschiedlichen internen Stakeholdern.  
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.  
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Das wäre ein Plus:
  • Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung oder beruflichen Weiterbildung.  
  • AEVO-Schein (AdA), Train the Trainer oder eine vergleichbare berufspädagogische Qualifikation.  
  • Erfahrung mit Python, Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, BI oder generativer AI.  


Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Work & Travel: Verbinde deinen Job mit Reisen – bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Ob du die Welt bereisen, Abenteuer erleben oder dich einfach erholen möchtest – wir geben dir den Freiraum dafür.
  • Weiterbildung: Lebenslanges Lernen gehört bei uns dazu! Wir fördern dich bei deiner Karriereplanung.
  • Wellhub: Für mehr Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und Bewegung – mit digitalen Tools und Fitnessangeboten vor Ort, ganz flexibel nach deinem Bedarf.
  • Team Spirit: Wir setzen auf ein Miteinander – flache Hierarchien, Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Teamtreffen.
  • Zukunftsorientiert: Wir sichern dich ab – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge bis zum Kindergartenzuschuss. Wir denken heute schon an übermorgen für dich und deine Familie!
  • Corporate Benefits: Auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Deal? Bei uns bekommst du zahlreiche Vergünstigungen und exklusive Angebote.


Hier wirst du gebraucht

Wir freuen uns auf deine Unterstützung an unseren Umschulungsstandorten in Augsburg, Braunschweig, Bremen, Köln, Leipzig und München. Teile uns deinen bevorzugten Arbeitsort einfach im Rahmen deiner Bewerbung mit!

  • Planung, Leitung und technische Umsetzung von IT-Projekten und Migrationen sowie Koordination interner Beteiligter, externer Dienstleister und Hersteller
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Betriebs- und Notfalldokumentationen sowie fachliche Unterstützung weniger erfahrener Teammitglieder

  • Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Migrationsprojekten
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse in Exchange-Hybridszenarien, SQL, LDAP, PKI oder weiteren Programmiersprachen sowie Erfahrungen im Incident-, Change- und Problem-Management nach ITIL

title: Senior Associate (m/w/d) Restrukturierung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Brl
description_html:
Es kommt drauf an - wo und mit wem man arbeitet!

Vollzeit | unbefristet | zu sofort

Wenn Finanzierung, Strategie und Recht zusammenfinden müssen, kommt es auf Menschen an, die den Überblick behalten. 

Wir beraten unsere Mandanten mit klarem Blick für das Machbare: von der frühzeitigen Krisenerkennung und der Restrukturierung von Finanzierungen über StaRUG-Strukturen bis hin zu komplexen M&A- und Carve-out-Prozessen. Dabei verbinden wir rechtliche Präzision mit wirtschaftlichem Verständnis und arbeiten eng mit unseren Experten aus Corporate, M&A, Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung zusammen. 
Für unser wachsendes Restrukturierungsteam suchen wir Sie als Senior Associate (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung. Sie arbeiten unmittelbar mit Mandanten und Finanzierungspartnern, übernehmen früh Verantwortung und gestalten anspruchsvolle Lösungen aktiv mit. 


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie beraten Unternehmen, Gesellschafter und Finanzierungspartner in Krisen- und Restrukturierungssituationen.
  • Sie begleitenvorinsolvenzliche Restrukturierungen, insbesondere StaRUG-Verfahren.
  • Sie gestalten und verhandeln Sanierungsvereinbarungen sowie Kredit- und Finanzierungsverträge.
  • Sie begleiten M&A-Transaktionen mit finanzierungsrechtlichem Schwerpunkt.
  • Sie übernehmen eigene Mandatsverantwortung und gestalten den weiteren Ausbau unseres Restrukturierungsbereichs aktiv mit.


Ihr Profil

  • Volljurist/in mit überdurchschnittlichen Examina
  • Min. vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzberatung
  • Unternehmerisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis
  • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Teamplayer mit sicherem Auftreten und Freude am Mandantenkontakt
  • Ausgeprägte Affinität zu digitalen Arbeitsweisen und neuen Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, deren Einsatz in der Mandatsarbeit weiterzuentwickeln
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

  • Mandate mit Wirkung: Sie arbeiten an Situationen, in denen rechtliche Entscheidungen unmittelbare wirtschaftliche Bedeutung haben – und helfen Mandanten, wieder Handlungsspielraum zu gewinnen. 
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Rechtsanwälte, Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und Restrukturierungsexperten sitzen bei uns unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht kurze Wege und Lösungen, die rechtliche, finanzielle und steuerliche Perspektiven verbinden. 
  • Technologie im Wandel: KI und Digitalisierung verändern auch die Arbeit in der Restrukturierung. Bei BRL erleben Sie diese Entwicklung nicht nur bei unseren Mandanten, sondern gestalten sie in einer multidisziplinären Kanzlei mit. 
  • Verantwortung und Entwicklung: Sie erhalten früh direkten Mandantenkontakt, übernehmen Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche und entwickeln sich in einem strategisch wachsenden Beratungsfeld weiter. 
  • Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, kommunizieren offen und unterstützen einander auch dann, wenn Mandate komplex und zeitkritisch werden.
  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. 
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile: Individuelle Weiterbildung, Mobilitätszuschüsse. 
  • Vergütung:  Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit leistungsbezogener Komponente, Entwicklungsperspektive und Beteiligung an geworbenen Mandaten.
